```ts
It's the part of you that has witnessed every joy and every challenge, yet remains untainted.

Allow this inner light to glow. Feel its warmth. Notice its gentle radiance.

Thoughts may arise. Feelings may come and go. Physical sensations may shift.

Rest in this awareness of your inner light. This place of peace, this source of calm.
It is your unchanging essence, your home.
You can always return to this inner sanctuary, this gentle glow, whenever you need to feel grounded.

As we prepare to close this practice, take one more deep, expansive breath.
Inhaling the knowing of this inner light, and exhaling gratitude for its constant presence.
Gently bring your awareness back to your body, back to the room.
When you're ready, slowly open your eyes, carrying the quiet glow of your inner light with you.`,

const relaxationResponse: MeditationScript = {
  id: "gen-relaxation-response",
  title: "The Relaxation Response",
  subtitle: "Deep rest through focused attention",
  category: "meditation",
  durationSec: 720,
  description: "A structured practice using a focus word, passive attitude, and gentle muscle relaxation to elicit the body's natural relaxation response.",
  evidenceSource: "Herbert Benson, The Relaxation Response",
  tags: ["relaxation", "stress-relief", "focus", "herbert-benson"],
  phase: "all",
  backgroundMusic: "binaural",
  ttsScript: `Welcome to The Relaxation Response.
This practice is designed to help you access your body's innate ability to rest and heal.
Find a quiet place where you won't be disturbed. Sit or lie down in a comfortable position. Allow your body to feel entirely supported.

Gently close your eyes.

Let's begin by taking a few deep, intentional breaths.
Inhale slowly and deeply through your nose, feeling your abdomen rise.
Exhale gently through your mouth, allowing your body to soften and release any tension.
Do this two more times. Inhale… and exhale… One more time, a deep inhale… and a complete exhale.
Now, allow your breathing to return to its natural, effortless rhythm.

Our focus for this practice involves three elements: a gentle focus word, a passive attitude, and progressive muscle relaxation.

First, choose a simple, neutral word or sound. Something that feels calming to you.
Perhaps it's "peace," or "one," or "love," or simply the sound "Om."
Quietly, to yourself, repeat this chosen word or sound. Let it be a soft, gentle anchor for your mind.

Now, let's turn our attention to progressive muscle relaxation.
Starting with your feet, gently tighten the muscles. Hold for five… four… three… two… one… and then completely relax.

Move your awareness up to your lower legs. Gently tense your calf muscles. Hold… five… four… three… two… one… and release.

Now your thighs. Tighten these muscles… five… four… three… two… one… and release.

Your abdomen. Gently tighten… five… four… three… two… one… and relax.

Your hands. Clench your fists. Squeeze… five… four… three… two… one… and release.

Your shoulders. Shrug them up towards your ears. Hold… five… four… three… two… one… and drop them completely.

Your face. Squint your eyes, clench your jaw… five… four… three… two… one… and release. Let your jaw hang loose, your forehead smooth.

Now, allow your entire body to rest in this state of deep relaxation.
Return your focus to your chosen word or sound. Repeat it gently, silently, each time you exhale.

The key element is a passive attitude. Thoughts will arise. That's natural. When you notice your mind has wandered, simply say to yourself, "Oh well," and gently return to your focus word.
You are not trying to stop thinking, but creating gentle space for thoughts to pass through.

Allow yourself to drift into a state of deep rest, a quiet awareness.
Embrace the stillness. Embrace the quiet repetition of your word.
You are safe. You are held. You are allowing your body to do what it naturally knows how to do: rest and rejuvenate.

As we near the end, begin to bring gentle awareness back to your surroundings.
Wiggle your fingers and toes. Take a slow, deep breath.
When you feel ready, slowly open your eyes. Carry this sense of calm with you.`,
  steps: [
    { id: "s1", title: "Settle", body: "Deep breaths and find comfort.", startTimeSec: 0, endTimeSec: 90 },
    { id: "s2", title: "Focus Word", body: "Choose a calming word as your anchor.", startTimeSec: 90, endTimeSec: 140 },
    { id: "s3", title: "Muscle Relaxation", body: "Progressive tense-and-release from feet to face.", startTimeSec: 140, endTimeSec: 420 },
    { id: "s4", title: "Deep Rest", body: "Repeat focus word with passive attitude.", startTimeSec: 420, endTimeSec: 660 },
    { id: "s5", title: "Return", body: "Gently reawaken and carry calm.", startTimeSec: 660, endTimeSec: 720 },
  ],
};

  ttsScript: `Welcome to the Sleep Body Melt.

Arrange your pillows and blankets so you feel cosy and warm.

And exhale completely through your mouth, letting out a soft sigh, releasing the day.
Do this two more times, each exhale carrying away a little more tension.

Begin with your feet. Curl your toes tightly, clench the muscles in your feet. Hold for five… four… three… two… one… and then completely relax. Feel the warmth as your feet soften and sink into the mattress.

Move up to your lower legs. Gently tighten your calf muscles. Hold… five… four… three… two… one… and exhale, releasing all effort.

Now your hands. Make soft fists. Squeeze gently… five… four… three… two… one… and release. Let your hands be soft and open.

Your belly. Gently tense your abdominal muscles. Hold… five… four… three… two… one… and release. Allow your belly to be soft.

Your shoulders. Gently shrug them up towards your ears. Hold… five… four… three… two… one… and drop them completely. Feel the weight of the day releasing.

Now, allow your entire body to melt into the bed. From the top of your head, down to the tips of your toes, feel a wave of profound relaxation wash over you.

If your mind begins to wander, simply guide your attention back to the sensation of your breath, or to the peaceful stillness within your body.

Rest here, allowing yourself to drift naturally into a peaceful, restorative sleep.
You are safe. You are warm. You are utterly at ease.
Let yourself go.
Good night.`,

The distant hoot of an owl, the soft chirping of crickets on the banks.
No harsh noises, just the soothing symphony of the natural world at rest.

With each gentle sway, each soft breath, feel yourself becoming softer, heavier, more deeply relaxed.
Imagine any worries drifting away from you, like tiny leaves floating downstream, out of sight.

Your eyelids feel heavy now. Your muscles are completely relaxed.
Your breath is slow and deep.
You are completely safe, completely held by the river, by the night.

Continue to float, carried by the gentle current of sleep.
The boat knows where it's going. You don't need to do anything but relax and trust.
Let the darkness and the quiet embrace you.
Drift now, into peaceful dreams.
Good night.`,

const understandingPatterns: MeditationScript = {
  id: "gen-understanding-patterns",
  title: "Understanding Your Patterns",
  subtitle: "Identify triggers and drivers of habits",
  category: "inner-work",
  durationSec: 720,
  description: "A guided reflection to compassionately explore the triggers, thoughts, and consequences of habitual or compulsive behaviours.",
  evidenceSource: "CRAFT approach (Foote, Wilkens, Kosanke) — Beyond Addiction",
  tags: ["addiction-recovery", "self-awareness", "patterns", "triggers", "inner-work"],
  phase: "all",
  backgroundMusic: "gentle",
  ttsScript: `Welcome to Understanding Your Patterns.
Find a quiet space where you can sit comfortably and be undisturbed.
Allow yourself to settle into your seat, feeling grounded and supported.
Gently close your eyes.

Take a few deep, intentional breaths. Inhale slowly through your nose. Exhale completely through your mouth.
Allow your breath to find a natural, gentle rhythm.

Today, we're going to gently explore some of the patterns in your life, particularly those that might feel challenging or compulsive. This isn't about judgment or blame, but about compassionate curiosity. We're shining a light, not to criticise, but to understand.

Bring to mind a specific behaviour or habit that you're interested in understanding better.
Perhaps it's a way you react to stress, or a substance you turn to, or an action you find yourself repeating even when you don't fully intend to.

Now, let's explore this pattern.
First, think about the Triggers.
What situations or feelings often precede this behaviour? Is it stress, loneliness, boredom, anger, exhaustion, a specific time of day, a particular place, or certain people?
Just observe, without judgment. What lights the fuse?

Next, consider the Thoughts and Feelings that arise just before the behaviour.
What thoughts run through your mind? "I deserve this." "I can't cope." "Just this once."
What emotions do you feel? A craving, a restlessness, anxiety, emptiness?
Allow yourself to simply notice these internal signals. They are messengers, not commands.

Then comes the Behaviour itself.
What exactly do you do? How does it feel in the moment?
Is there a sense of relief, pleasure, escape, or perhaps a temporary numbing?

And finally, consider the Consequences.
What happens immediately after? And later?
Do you feel regret, shame, disappointment? What are the longer-term impacts?

Repeat this journey: Trigger… Thoughts… Behaviour… Consequences.
Do it slowly, with kindness.
This insight isn't about shaming yourself, but about empowering yourself.

Perhaps you notice something new this time. A subtle thought, a hidden feeling, a trigger you hadn't fully recognised.
This understanding is like holding a map. It shows you the territory.

Offer yourself compassion for whatever arises. These patterns often serve a purpose. They are often born from a desire to cope, to feel better, or to escape discomfort.

As we bring this reflection to a close, take a deep breath.
Remember, awareness is the first step toward change. You've taken a powerful step today.
When you're ready, gently open your eyes.`,

    { id: "s4", title: "Compassion", body: "Acknowledge purpose behind the pattern.", startTimeSec: 540, endTimeSec: 660 },

};

const rootBeneathRoot: MeditationScript = {
  id: "gen-root-beneath-root",
  title: "The Root Beneath the Root",
  subtitle: "Deep inquiry into addiction's emotional drivers",
  category: "inner-work",
  durationSec: 900,
  description: "A profound guided inquiry to gently explore the underlying emotional needs that a compulsive behaviour attempts to soothe.",
  evidenceSource: "Internal Family Systems (IFS) & Beyond Addiction (Foote et al.)",
  tags: ["addiction-recovery", "inner-work", "emotional-needs", "self-compassion"],
  phase: "all",
  backgroundMusic: "binaural",
  ttsScript: `Welcome to The Root Beneath the Root.
Find a quiet, private space where you can sit or lie down comfortably.
Allow yourself to fully relax, feeling the support beneath you.
Gently close your eyes, turning your attention inward.

Take three slow, deep, grounding breaths.
Inhale fully. Exhale completely, letting out any tension, any rush, any need to be anywhere but here.
Allow your breath to settle into a soft, steady rhythm.

Today, we're going to embark on a compassionate journey inward. A journey to gently explore what lies beneath our habitual responses.
This isn't about judgment, but about deep, loving understanding.

Bring to mind a specific pattern or behaviour you want to understand more deeply. Hold it gently in your awareness.

Now, sense the impulse or the craving for this behaviour. Where do you feel it in your body? Is it a tightness, a hollow feeling, a restless energy?
And what feeling typically precedes this impulse? Is it stress, loneliness, anxiety, boredom, emptiness, anger, fear, or a sense of not being enough?
Just allow that primary feeling to surface.

As you hold this feeling, ask yourself, with gentle curiosity:
"What is this feeling trying to tell me?"
"What is it that I truly need in this moment, that this behaviour is attempting to provide?"

Perhaps the behaviour offers a temporary escape from discomfort.
If so, what discomfort? Is it pain, sadness, overwhelm?
What is the real need behind the desire to escape? Is it a need for safety, for peace, for connection, for rest?

Perhaps the behaviour offers a sense of comfort or reward.
What kind of comfort? What is the real need? Is it a need for love, for acceptance, for joy?

Perhaps the behaviour offers a sense of control.
Where do you feel powerless? What is the real need? Is it a need for agency, for stability?

Go deeper. If the behaviour is trying to fill a void, what is the nature of that void?
Is it a longing for connection? A yearning for meaning? A desire for self-worth?

Imagine peeling back layers, one by one.
The behaviour…
Beneath it, the surface feeling…
And beneath that, the deeper, often unacknowledged, emotional need.
The root beneath the root.

When you identify this deeper need, give it space.
Do you need to feel loved? Safe? Seen? Do you need rest? Joy? Quiet?
Acknowledge it fully.

Now, offer this genuine need compassion.
Imagine placing a warm, gentle hand over your heart.
Silently, say to yourself:
"It is okay to have this need."
"I am here for this part of myself."
"I will listen."

You might not find all the answers today, and that's perfectly okay. The awareness itself is the most powerful step.

As we bring this practice to a close, take a final deep breath.
Inhaling self-compassion, and exhaling the intention to continue listening to your deepest needs.
When you're ready, gently open your eyes.`,

    { id: "s3", title: "Inquiry", body: "Ask what need the behaviour serves.", startTimeSec: 250, endTimeSec: 600 },

const releasingWithoutReplacing: MeditationScript = {
  id: "gen-releasing-without-replacing",
  title: "Releasing Without Replacing",
  subtitle: "Sitting with discomfort without habitual reactions",
  category: "inner-work",
  durationSec: 600,
  description: "Learn to observe uncomfortable sensations and urges without immediately reacting or seeking to replace them with a habitual response.",
  evidenceSource: "ACT & Mindfulness-Based Relapse Prevention (MBRP)",
  tags: ["addiction-recovery", "discomfort-tolerance", "urges", "self-compassion"],
  phase: "all",
  backgroundMusic: "gentle",
  ttsScript: `Welcome to Releasing Without Replacing.
Find a comfortable position, whether seated or lying down, where you can remain still and undisturbed.
Gently close your eyes.

Take a slow, deep breath in through your nose, and exhale fully through your mouth, letting out a soft sigh.
Do this two more times, letting each exhale help you settle deeper.
Allow your breath to return to its natural rhythm.

Today, we're going to practice a crucial skill: learning to sit with discomfort without immediately reacting or reaching for a familiar habit to soothe ourselves. This is about creating space, observing, and allowing emotions and urges to simply be.

Bring to mind a mild, manageable discomfort or an urge you sometimes experience.
Perhaps it's restlessness, a subtle craving, mild anxiety, boredom, or a physical itch.
Choose something that feels accessible to observe right now, not an overwhelming crisis.

As you bring this sensation into your awareness, notice where you feel it in your body.
Is it a tightness in your chest? A fluttering in your stomach? An agitation in your hands?

Now, instead of immediately responding, simply lean into observing it.
Imagine it as a cloud passing in the sky. You don't need to grab it, or follow it, or make it go away.
Can you notice its shape? Its intensity? Does it have a temperature? Is it constant, or does it ebb and flow?

Bring a gentle, curious awareness to it.
What is it really like to simply feel this discomfort, without the layer of resistance or the usual scramble to escape it?
Notice any thoughts that arise: "I don't like this," "I need to do something." Acknowledge these thoughts too, as simply more clouds passing.

With each breath, imagine creating more space around this sensation.
You are not the discomfort. You are the awareness that is observing the discomfort.
This space, this awareness, is unconditioned, unchanging, safe.

This practice is not about enduring pain, but about recognising that urges and uncomfortable feelings are temporary. They rise, they peak, and they fall.
By not acting on the urge, you allow it the space to run its course.
You are strengthening your capacity to respond rather than react.

It takes courage to do this. Offer yourself deep compassion for being willing to sit in this space.
There is immense strength in simply allowing something to be.

Rest in this open, accepting awareness for a few more moments.
Just breathing, just observing, just allowing.

As we draw this practice to a close, take a final deep, centring breath.
Acknowledge the courageous work you have done today.
When you're ready, gently open your eyes, carrying this expanded capacity for non-reactivity with you.`,
```

```ts
export type HabitFrequencyType = "daily" | "weekly" | "monthly";

export interface SupplementRDI {
  amount: string;
  unit: string;
  nzRdi: string;
  upperLimit?: string;
  timing: string;
  foodSources: string[];
  phaseNotes?: Partial<Record<Phase, string>>;

  modern: string;
  tcm?: string;
  ayurveda?: string;

  | "bone-muscle" | "energy-mood" | "gut-microbiome" | "immune-thyroid" 
  | "skin-hair-nails" | "hormonal-balance" | "brain-cognition" | "anti-inflammatory";

export function getLibraryHabitsForCategory(category: HabitCategory): LibraryHabit[] {
  return HABIT_LIBRARY.filter(h => h.category === category);
}

/** Parse a free-text frequency string into a frequency type bucket */
export function parseFrequencyType(freq: string): HabitFrequencyType {
  const f = freq.toLowerCase();
  if (f.includes("month") || f.includes("as scheduled") || f.includes("as booked")) return "monthly";
  if (f.includes("week") || f.includes("2x") || f.includes("3x") || f.includes("1–2x") || f.includes("2–3x") || f.includes("3–4x")) return "weekly";
  return "daily";
}
```

## `src/data/image-style-guide.md`

```md
# Signal Visual Style Guide

## Illustration Style: Minimalist Hand-Drawn Watercolor

### Core Characteristics
- **Line work**: Thin, hand-drawn pen outlines in warm brown/sienna tone
- **Fill**: Mostly white/empty with subtle watercolor washes
- **Color**: One or two pops of color per illustration aligned to brand palette
- **Background**: Transparent (PNG) — never white squares
- **Composition**: Centered, simple, single subject
- **Texture**: Slight hand-drawn imperfection, organic feel
- **Detail level**: Minimal — suggest rather than render photorealistically

### Brand Color Palette (HSL)
- **Primary**: 270 30% 55% (soft purple)
- **Menstrual phase**: Warm reds, deep rose (#C4526E)
- **Follicular phase**: Deep purple (#5C4A9E)
- **Ovulatory phase**: Warm pink (#C47A8A)
- **Luteal phase**: Muted lavender (#9B89B4)
- **Accent earthy**: Warm terracotta, sage green, soft amber

---

## Year of Coming Home (YOCH) Journal Reference

Reference images stored in `src/assets/reference/`:

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `yoch-weekly-spread.png` | Open book spread — left page: intention/mantra/gratitude; right page: daily blocks |
| `yoch-colouring.png` | Mindful colouring page — line art with celestial/botanical motifs |
| `yoch-trust-page.png` | Prose page — centered text with stars/moon line art header |
| `yoch-weekly-reflection.png` | Weekly reflection — boxed prompts with hand-drawn sun/flower icons |
| `yoch-reflection-prompts.png` | Reflection prompts — dotted borders, hand-drawn celestial icons |
| `yoch-warm-hug.png` | Activity page — woman illustration with flowers, writable heart space |
| `yoch-return-to-body.png` | Body check-in — woman with flowers, reflective prompt lines |

### Key Visual Elements to Replicate
1. **Hand-drawn borders**: Thin line borders with rounded corners, slightly imperfect/organic
2. **Dotted separators**: Rows of small circles as section dividers (○ ○ ○ ○ ○)
3. **Celestial motifs**: Stars (✦ ✧), crescent moons, suns with radiating lines
4. **Botanical motifs**: Simple leaf sprigs, small flowers, branch elements
5. **Line-art illustrations**: Women with flowers, embracing figures, nature scenes
6. **Typography**: Mix of clean serif headings + handwritten (Caveat) for prompts/notes

### Prompt Template for YOCH-Style Illustrations
```
Minimalist hand-drawn line art illustration of [SUBJECT] in the style of a wellness journal.
Thin brown/warm gray pen outlines only, no fill colors, delicate botanical and celestial
accents (small stars, moons, flowers, leaves). Clean white background, gentle and feminine
aesthetic. Suitable for a mindful journaling page.
```

### Prompt Template for Brand-Colored Watercolor
```
Hand-drawn minimalist watercolor illustration of [SUBJECT] on a solid white background.
Thin brown pen outlines with subtle [BRAND COLOR] watercolor accents. Transparent background.
Simple, elegant illustration with organic hand-drawn quality. No text, no labels.
```

---

## SVG Hand-Drawn Borders

For UI elements, use the `JournalBorders` component (`src/components/JournalBorders.tsx`)
which provides organic, slightly imperfect border SVGs matching the YOCH aesthetic.

Available variants:
- `HandDrawnBox` — Rounded rectangle with organic wobble
- `DottedDivider` — Row of hand-drawn circles
- `CelestialHeader` — Stars and moon decorative header
- `BotanicalCorner` — Small leaf/flower corner accent
- `JournalSection` — Full section wrapper with hand-drawn border + optional title

```

```ts
/**
 * Kid-friendly dinner alternatives mapped by dinner name keywords.
 */
export const KIDS_DINNER_ALTERNATIVES: Record<string, string> = {
  "miso": "Plain soba noodles with tamari dipping sauce + steamed broccoli + edamame. Same noodles, simpler flavours.",
  "bolognese": "Pasta with a mild tomato and lentil sauce — blend the lentils smooth if texture is an issue. Add nutritional yeast for cheesy flavour.",
  "chickpea curry": "Mild coconut rice with chickpeas — reduce spices to just cumin and a pinch of turmeric. Serve with flatbread.",
  "chickpea & sweet potato curry": "Mild coconut rice with chickpeas — reduce spices to just cumin and a pinch of turmeric. Serve with flatbread.",
  "tempeh stir": "Plain rice + steamed vegetables + tamari. Swap tempeh for plain tofu if needed.",
  "thai green curry": "Coconut rice with mild sautéed veggies. Use only 1 tsp curry paste and extra coconut milk to reduce heat.",
  "thai": "Coconut rice with mild sautéed veggies. Use only 1 tsp curry paste and extra coconut milk to reduce heat.",
  "mushroom risotto": "Cheese-free creamy rice — use extra oat milk and nutritional yeast. Kids usually love this one as-is.",
  "shakshuka": "Scrambled silken tofu on toast with a very mild tomato sauce. Skip the spices.",
  "pad thai": "Plain rice noodles with peanut butter sauce (PB + tamari + lime). Most kids love peanut noodles.",
  "lentil dhal": "Plain rice with a very mild lentil sauce — blend smooth and skip the chilli. Add a squeeze of lemon.",
  "shepherd": "Mashed sweet potato on its own with a side of steamed veggies. Most kids love the mash.",
  "casserole": "Serve the root vegetables and lentils separated — kids do better when they can see each component.",
  "tikka masala": "Mild coconut rice with chickpeas — skip the tikka spice. Add a dollop of coconut yoghurt.",
  "chilli": "Mild bean and rice bowl — reduce chilli powder to a pinch. Top with avocado.",
  "lasagne": "Plain pasta with cashew cream sauce. Serve vegetables on the side.",
  "dhal": "Plain rice with a very mild lentil sauce — blend smooth and skip the chilli.",
  "stew": "Serve the protein and vegetables separated with crusty bread for dipping.",
  "pumpkin curry": "Roasted pumpkin pieces with plain rice and a drizzle of coconut cream.",
  "asparagus": "Plain quinoa with cucumber sticks and a tahini dipping sauce.",
  "stuffed capsicum": "Plain quinoa and black beans served separately with corn on the side.",
  "fritters": "Plain fritters served with cucumber sticks and hummus.",
};

const GENERIC_KID_TIP = "Serve the main protein and carb plain for kids, with the sauce on the side. Most children do better with simpler flavours and separated components.";

export function getKidAlternative(dinnerName: string): string {
  const lower = dinnerName.toLowerCase();
  for (const [key, alt] of Object.entries(KIDS_DINNER_ALTERNATIVES)) {
    if (lower.includes(key)) return alt;
  }
  return GENERIC_KID_TIP;
}

```

```ts
  { id: "kids-bean-nachos", name: "Bean & Cheese Nachos", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "beans", prepTime: "15 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["1 bag corn chips","1 can refried beans or black beans","1 cup grated cheese","½ cup corn","¼ cup sour cream","guacamole (optional)"], method: ["Spread corn chips on baking tray","Dollop beans and sprinkle cheese and corn","Bake at 180°C for 8-10 minutes until cheese melts","Serve with sour cream"], tags: ["vegetarian","nut-free","egg-free","gluten-free"], similarity: ["mexican","cheese","crispy"] },

  // ── EGGS ──
  { id: "kids-egg-fried-rice", name: "Egg Fried Rice", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "15 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["2 cups cold cooked rice","3 eggs, beaten","1 cup frozen peas and corn","2 tbsp soy sauce","1 tbsp sesame oil","1 spring onion, sliced"], method: ["Scramble eggs in sesame oil, break into small pieces","Add rice and vegetables, cook 3 minutes","Add soy sauce, toss and serve"], tags: ["vegetarian","nut-free","dairy-free"], similarity: ["stir-fry","rice-bowl","asian"] },
  { id: "kids-frittata", name: "Veggie Mini Frittatas", mealType: ["breakfast","lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 6, ingredients: ["6 eggs","½ cup grated cheese","½ cup diced capsicum","½ cup corn","¼ cup milk","salt and pepper"], method: ["Preheat oven to 180°C, grease muffin tin","Whisk eggs with milk, salt and pepper","Divide vegetables and cheese into muffin cups","Pour egg mixture over, bake 15-18 minutes"], tags: ["vegetarian","nut-free","gluten-free"] },
  { id: "kids-french-toast", name: "French Toast Fingers", mealType: ["breakfast","lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "15 min", serves: 2, ingredients: ["4 slices bread, cut into strips","2 eggs","¼ cup milk","½ tsp cinnamon","1 tsp butter","maple syrup or fruit to serve"], method: ["Whisk eggs, milk and cinnamon","Dip bread strips into egg mixture","Cook in buttered pan 2 minutes each side until golden","Serve with maple syrup or fruit"], tags: ["vegetarian","nut-free"] },

  // ── CHEESE / PASTA ──
  { id: "kids-mac-cheese", name: "Classic Mac & Cheese", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "cheese", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["300g macaroni","2 cups grated cheese","1 cup milk","2 tbsp butter","2 tbsp flour","pinch mustard powder"], method: ["Cook macaroni","Melt butter, stir in flour, gradually add milk","Stir in cheese until smooth","Combine with pasta and serve"], tags: ["vegetarian","nut-free","egg-free"], similarity: ["pasta","cheese","comfort"] },
  { id: "kids-cheese-pizza", name: "Easy Cheese Pizza", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "cheese", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["4 pita breads or pizza bases","½ cup pizza sauce","2 cups grated mozzarella","toppings: corn, capsicum, mushroom, ham"], method: ["Preheat oven to 200°C","Spread sauce on bases, add cheese and toppings","Bake 10-12 minutes until cheese is bubbly","Let kids choose their own toppings"], tags: ["vegetarian","nut-free","egg-free"], similarity: ["pizza","cheese"] },

  // ── PORK ──
  { id: "kids-pork-dumplings", name: "Pork & Veggie Dumplings", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "pork", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["250g pork mince","1 cup finely shredded cabbage","1 carrot, grated","1 tbsp soy sauce","1 tsp sesame oil","24 dumpling wrappers","dipping sauce: soy + rice vinegar"], method: ["Mix pork, cabbage, carrot, soy sauce, sesame oil","Place 1 tbsp filling in each wrapper, fold and seal","Steam for 10-12 minutes or pan-fry until golden","Serve with dipping sauce"], tags: ["nut-free","dairy-free"], similarity: ["asian","dumpling"], image: "/images/recipes/meals/kids-pork-dumplings.png" },
  { id: "kids-pork-stir-fry", name: "Sweet & Sour Pork with Rice", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "pork", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["300g pork loin, sliced","1 capsicum, diced","1 cup pineapple chunks","2 tbsp tomato sauce","1 tbsp soy sauce","1 tbsp honey","2 cups rice"], method: ["Cook rice","Stir-fry pork until cooked","Add capsicum and pineapple","Mix tomato sauce, soy sauce and honey, add to pan","Serve over rice"], tags: ["nut-free","dairy-free","egg-free","gluten-free"], similarity: ["stir-fry","asian","sweet-sour"], image: "/images/recipes/meals/kids-pork-stir-fry.png" },

  // ── SHRIMP ──  
  { id: "kids-shrimp-pasta", name: "Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "shrimp", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["300g pasta","200g shrimp, peeled","2 tbsp butter","2 cloves garlic, minced","¼ cup parmesan","1 cup baby spinach"], method: ["Cook pasta","Sauté garlic in butter, add shrimp and cook 3 minutes","Add spinach until wilted","Toss with pasta and parmesan"], tags: ["nut-free","egg-free"], similarity: ["pasta","garlic"] },

  // ── PALEO-INSPIRED KIDS RECIPES ──

  // Breakfasts (paleo-friendly)
  { id: "kids-paleo-banana-muffins", name: "Banana Cinnamon Muffins", mealType: ["breakfast","lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 6, ingredients: ["3 ripe bananas","4 eggs","½ cup almond flour","¼ cup coconut flour","1 tbsp cinnamon","1 tsp vanilla extract","¼ tsp sea salt"], method: ["Preheat oven to 175°C","Mash bananas, whisk in eggs and vanilla","Mix flours, cinnamon, salt separately","Combine wet and dry, spoon into greased muffin tin","Bake 25-30 minutes until springy"], tags: ["dairy-free","gluten-free"] },
  { id: "kids-paleo-sweet-potato-pancakes", name: "Sweet Potato Silver Dollar Pancakes", mealType: ["breakfast","lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["2 small sweet potatoes (350g)","½ banana, mashed","2 eggs","¼ tsp baking soda","pinch ground ginger","coconut oil for cooking"], method: ["Microwave sweet potatoes until soft, scoop out flesh","Mash with banana, stir in eggs, baking soda, ginger","Heat coconut oil in pan","Drop small spoonfuls, cook 3 min each side","Serve with fresh fruit"], tags: ["dairy-free","gluten-free","nut-free"] },
  { id: "kids-paleo-veggie-scramble", name: "Rainbow Veggie Scramble", mealType: ["breakfast","lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "15 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["6 eggs","1 cup diced capsicum","½ cup diced zucchini","½ cup cherry tomatoes, halved","1 tbsp olive oil","pinch salt"], method: ["Whisk eggs with salt","Sauté capsicum and zucchini in olive oil 2 minutes","Add tomatoes, cook 1 minute","Pour in eggs, gently scramble until just set","Serve immediately"], tags: ["dairy-free","gluten-free","nut-free"] },
  { id: "kids-paleo-breakfast-hash", name: "Sweet Potato Breakfast Hash", mealType: ["breakfast","lunch","dinner"], protein: "pork", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["2 sweet potatoes, cubed small","4 pork sausages (gluten-free), sliced","1 apple, diced","1 tbsp coconut oil","½ tsp cinnamon","pinch salt"], method: ["Heat coconut oil in large skillet","Cook sweet potato cubes 8-10 min until tender","Add sausage slices, cook until browned","Toss in apple and cinnamon, cook 2 more minutes","Season and serve"], tags: ["dairy-free","gluten-free","nut-free","egg-free"] },
  { id: "kids-paleo-oven-pancake", name: "Berry Puff Pancake", mealType: ["breakfast","lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["1 cup almond flour","6 eggs","½ cup coconut milk","1 tsp cinnamon","1 tsp vanilla","2 tbsp butter or coconut oil","1 cup mixed berries","maple syrup to serve"], method: ["Preheat oven to 190°C, melt butter in cast-iron pan in oven","Whisk almond flour, cinnamon with eggs, coconut milk, vanilla","Pour into hot pan, scatter berries on top","Bake 20-25 minutes until puffed and golden","Serve with a drizzle of maple syrup"], tags: ["dairy-free","gluten-free"] },

  // Lunches (paleo-friendly)
  { id: "kids-paleo-chicken-strips", name: "Crunchy Coconut Chicken Strips", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["500g chicken breast, sliced into strips","1 cup unsweetened shredded coconut","½ cup almond flour","1 egg, beaten","½ tsp paprika","¼ tsp garlic powder","pinch salt"], method: ["Preheat oven to 200°C","Mix coconut, almond flour, paprika, garlic, salt","Dip strips in egg, press into coconut mixture","Bake on lined tray 15-18 minutes until golden","Serve with lemon wedges"], tags: ["dairy-free","gluten-free"] },
  { id: "kids-paleo-turkey-burgers", name: "Mini Turkey Burgers on Sweet Potato Buns", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["500g turkey mince","1 grated zucchini, squeezed dry","1 tsp dried herbs","2 sweet potatoes, sliced into rounds","lettuce, tomato for topping","pinch salt"], method: ["Mix turkey, zucchini, herbs, salt and form small patties","Slice sweet potatoes into 1cm rounds, brush with oil","Bake sweet potato rounds at 200°C for 15 minutes","Pan-fry patties 4 min each side","Assemble burgers using sweet potato rounds as buns"], tags: ["dairy-free","gluten-free","nut-free","egg-free"], image: "/images/recipes/meals/kids-paleo-turkey-burgers.png" },
  { id: "kids-paleo-chicken-fajitas", name: "Lettuce Cup Chicken Fajitas", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["500g chicken breast, sliced into strips","1 capsicum, sliced","½ red onion, sliced","1 tsp cumin","1 tsp paprika","1 tbsp olive oil","butter lettuce leaves","guacamole to serve"], method: ["Toss chicken with cumin, paprika, salt","Heat olive oil, sear chicken until golden and cooked","Add capsicum and onion, cook 2 minutes","Spoon into lettuce cups","Top with guacamole"], tags: ["dairy-free","gluten-free","nut-free","egg-free"] },
  { id: "kids-paleo-tuna-nori-rolls", name: "Curried Tuna Nori Bites", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "fish", prepTime: "15 min", serves: 2, ingredients: ["1 can tuna, drained","½ avocado, mashed","1 tsp curry powder","1 tbsp lime juice","1 tsp raisins","2 nori sheets"], method: ["Mash avocado with curry powder and lime juice","Fold in tuna and raisins","Spread filling along edge of each nori sheet","Roll up tightly, slice into bite-size pieces","Serve immediately"], tags: ["dairy-free","gluten-free","nut-free","egg-free"] },
  { id: "kids-paleo-meatball-skewers", name: "Greek-Style Lamb Skewers", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["500g lamb mince","1 tsp dried oregano","½ tsp cumin","1 grated zucchini, squeezed dry","1 egg","cucumber sticks and cherry tomatoes to serve"], method: ["Mix lamb, oregano, cumin, zucchini, egg","Form into small oval shapes, thread onto skewers","Grill or bake at 200°C for 12-15 minutes","Serve with cucumber sticks and tomatoes"], tags: ["dairy-free","gluten-free","nut-free"], image: "/images/recipes/meals/kids-paleo-meatball-skewers.png" },
  { id: "kids-paleo-stuffed-peppers", name: "Pork & Cabbage Stuffed Peppers", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "pork", prepTime: "35 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["4 capsicums, tops removed and seeded","400g pork mince","1 cup finely shredded cabbage","1 carrot, grated","1 tsp Italian herbs","1 cup passata","salt to taste"], method: ["Preheat oven to 190°C","Brown pork mince, add cabbage, carrot, herbs, cook 3 min","Stir in half the passata","Stuff mixture into capsicums","Place in baking dish, pour remaining passata around","Bake 25 minutes until peppers are tender"], tags: ["dairy-free","gluten-free","nut-free","egg-free"], image: "/images/recipes/meals/kids-paleo-stuffed-peppers.png" },

  // Dinners (paleo-friendly)
  { id: "kids-paleo-shepherds-pie", name: "Cauliflower-Top Shepherd's Pie", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "40 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["500g beef mince","1 carrot, diced","1 celery stalk, diced","1 cup sweet potato, cubed","1 head cauliflower","2 tbsp olive oil","1 cup bone broth or stock","1 tsp thyme"], method: ["Brown mince with carrot, celery, thyme","Add stock and sweet potato, simmer 15 min","Steam cauliflower, mash with olive oil and salt","Spoon meat mixture into baking dish","Top with cauliflower mash, bake at 190°C for 15 min until golden"], tags: ["dairy-free","gluten-free","nut-free","egg-free"] },
  { id: "kids-paleo-pulled-pork", name: "Slow-Cooked Pulled Pork Bowls", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "pork", prepTime: "30 min + slow cook", serves: 6, ingredients: ["1kg pork shoulder","1 cup water","2 tsp dried basil","1 tsp rosemary","pinch salt","sweet potato pancakes or lettuce for serving","coleslaw to serve"], method: ["Place pork in slow cooker with water, herbs, salt","Cook on low 8 hours or high 4 hours","Shred with two forks","Toss with your favourite sauce","Serve in lettuce cups or over sweet potato pancakes with coleslaw"], tags: ["dairy-free","gluten-free","nut-free","egg-free"], image: "/images/recipes/meals/kids-paleo-pulled-pork.png" },
  { id: "kids-paleo-beef-stew", name: "Hearty Veggie Beef Stew", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "40 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g beef chuck, cubed","2 carrots, sliced","1 sweet potato, cubed","2 celery stalks, sliced","1 cup stock","1 tbsp tomato paste","1 tsp thyme","1 tsp rosemary","1 tbsp olive oil"], method: ["Brown beef cubes in olive oil, set aside","Sauté celery, add tomato paste","Add stock, carrots, sweet potato, herbs, return beef","Simmer covered for 30-40 minutes until tender","Season to taste and serve"], tags: ["dairy-free","gluten-free","nut-free","egg-free"], image: "/images/recipes/meals/kids-paleo-beef-stew.png" },
  { id: "kids-paleo-meatloaf", name: "Hidden Veggie Meatloaf", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "45 min", serves: 6, ingredients: ["500g beef mince","250g pork mince","1 carrot, grated","1 zucchini, grated","1 egg","½ cup almond flour","1 tsp Italian herbs","2 tbsp tomato paste","pinch salt"], method: ["Preheat oven to 180°C","Mix all ingredients thoroughly","Press into a lined loaf tin","Spread extra tomato paste on top","Bake 35-40 minutes until cooked through","Rest 10 minutes before slicing"], tags: ["dairy-free","gluten-free"] },
  { id: "kids-paleo-lamb-chops", name: "Herb-Crusted Lamb Chops with Root Mash", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["8 lamb chops","2 parsnips, cubed","2 carrots, cubed","1 tbsp olive oil","1 tsp dried rosemary","1 tsp dried thyme","salt and pepper"], method: ["Steam parsnips and carrots until soft, mash with olive oil","Brush lamb chops with oil, season with rosemary, thyme, salt","Grill or pan-fry 4-5 min each side","Serve chops on a bed of root vegetable mash"], tags: ["dairy-free","gluten-free","nut-free","egg-free"], image: "/images/recipes/meals/kids-paleo-lamb-chops.png" },
  { id: "kids-paleo-eggplant-lasagna", name: "Eggplant Layered Bake", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "pork", prepTime: "45 min", serves: 6, ingredients: ["1 large eggplant, sliced lengthwise","400g pork sausage meat","2 cups spinach","2 cups tomato passata","1 cup cashew cream or coconut cream","1 tsp dried oregano","1 tsp dried basil","1 tbsp olive oil"], method: ["Brush eggplant slices with oil, grill until tender","Brown sausage meat, add spinach until wilted","Layer in baking dish: passata, eggplant, meat, cream","Repeat layers, finish with passata and herbs","Bake at 180°C for 25 minutes until bubbling"], tags: ["dairy-free","gluten-free","egg-free"] },
  { id: "kids-paleo-curried-pork", name: "Mild Curried Pork with Apple", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "pork", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g pork loin, cubed","1 apple, diced","1 cup butternut pumpkin, cubed","1 can coconut milk","1 tsp mild curry powder","½ tsp turmeric","1 tbsp coconut oil","steamed rice or cauliflower rice"], method: ["Sauté pork in coconut oil until browned","Add curry powder and turmeric, stir 1 minute","Add pumpkin and coconut milk, simmer 15 min","Add apple, cook 5 more minutes","Serve over rice or cauliflower rice"], tags: ["dairy-free","gluten-free","nut-free","egg-free"], image: "/images/recipes/meals/kids-paleo-curried-pork.png" },

  // ── NEW ENGLAND-INSPIRED KIDS RECIPES ──
  { id: "kids-ne-granola-clusters", name: "Maple Oat Granola Clusters", mealType: ["breakfast","lunch"], protein: "none", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 8, ingredients: ["3 cups rolled oats","½ cup maple syrup","¼ cup coconut oil, melted","1 tsp cinnamon","½ cup pumpkin seeds","½ cup dried cranberries","pinch salt"], method: ["Preheat oven to 160°C","Mix oats, maple syrup, oil, cinnamon, salt","Press onto lined tray in a flat layer","Bake 25 minutes until golden, do not stir","Cool completely, break into clusters, toss with seeds and cranberries"], tags: ["vegan","dairy-free","egg-free"] },
  { id: "kids-ne-blueberry-muffins", name: "Fluffy Blueberry Muffins", mealType: ["breakfast","lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 12, ingredients: ["2 cups flour","½ cup sugar","1 egg","¾ cup milk","⅓ cup butter, melted","1½ cups blueberries","2 tsp baking powder","pinch salt"], method: ["Preheat oven to 190°C","Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, salt","Whisk egg, milk, butter separately","Combine wet and dry, fold in blueberries","Spoon into muffin tin, bake 20-22 minutes"], tags: ["nut-free"] },
  { id: "kids-ne-cornbread-bites", name: "Honey Cornbread Bites", mealType: ["breakfast","lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 8, ingredients: ["1 cup cornmeal","1 cup flour","¼ cup honey","1 egg","¾ cup milk","¼ cup butter, melted","2 tsp baking powder"], method: ["Preheat oven to 200°C","Mix cornmeal, flour, baking powder","Whisk egg, milk, honey, butter","Combine and pour into greased mini muffin tin","Bake 15 minutes until golden"], tags: ["nut-free"] },
  { id: "kids-ne-apple-oat-pancakes", name: "Apple Cinnamon Oat Pancakes", mealType: ["breakfast","lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["1 cup rolled oats, blended to flour","1 apple, grated","2 eggs","½ cup milk","1 tsp cinnamon","1 tsp baking powder","butter for cooking"], method: ["Blend oats to flour, mix with baking powder and cinnamon","Whisk eggs and milk, combine with dry ingredients","Fold in grated apple","Cook small pancakes in buttered pan 2-3 min each side","Serve with maple syrup"], tags: ["nut-free"] },
  { id: "kids-ne-fish-cakes", name: "Crispy Cod Fish Cakes", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "fish", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["300g cod fillet, cooked and flaked","2 medium potatoes, cooked and mashed","1 egg","2 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped","½ cup breadcrumbs","1 tsp lemon zest","salt and pepper","oil for frying"], method: ["Mix flaked cod with mashed potato, parsley, lemon zest, salt","Form into small patties","Dip in beaten egg, coat in breadcrumbs","Pan-fry in oil 3-4 min each side until golden","Serve with lemon wedges"], tags: ["nut-free","dairy-free"] },
  { id: "kids-ne-clam-chowder-pasta", name: "Creamy Chowder Pasta", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "fish", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["300g small pasta","200g canned white fish, drained","2 slices bacon, diced","1 potato, cubed small","1 cup milk","2 tbsp butter","2 tbsp flour","1 cup corn kernels"], method: ["Cook pasta, set aside","Fry bacon until crisp, add potato cubes and cook 5 min","Make roux with butter and flour, add milk gradually","Add fish, corn, bacon, and potato","Toss with pasta and serve"], tags: ["nut-free","egg-free"] },
  { id: "kids-ne-turkey-meatball-soup", name: "Turkey Meatball Vegetable Soup", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g turkey mince","1 egg","¼ cup breadcrumbs","4 cups chicken stock","2 carrots, diced","1 celery stalk, diced","1 cup small pasta","1 tsp Italian herbs"], method: ["Mix turkey, egg, breadcrumbs, herbs and form small meatballs","Bring stock to simmer, add carrots and celery","Drop in meatballs, cook 10 minutes","Add pasta, cook until tender","Season and serve"], tags: ["nut-free","dairy-free"] },
  { id: "kids-ne-salmon-bites", name: "Teriyaki Salmon Bites", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "fish", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g salmon fillet, cubed","2 tbsp soy sauce","1 tbsp honey","1 tsp ginger, grated","1 cup rice","1 cup steamed broccoli","1 tsp sesame seeds"], method: ["Mix soy sauce, honey, ginger","Toss salmon cubes in marinade","Bake at 200°C for 12-15 minutes","Serve over rice with broccoli","Sprinkle with sesame seeds"], tags: ["nut-free","dairy-free","egg-free","gluten-free"] },
  { id: "kids-ne-pumpkin-mac", name: "Pumpkin Mac & Cheese", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "cheese", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["300g macaroni","1 cup pumpkin purée","1½ cups grated cheddar","¾ cup milk","2 tbsp butter","1 tbsp flour","pinch nutmeg","salt"], method: ["Cook macaroni","Melt butter, stir in flour, add milk gradually","Add pumpkin purée and cheese, stir until smooth","Season with nutmeg and salt","Toss with pasta and serve"], tags: ["vegetarian","nut-free","egg-free"] },
  { id: "kids-ne-cranberry-chicken", name: "Cranberry Glazed Chicken Drumsticks", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "35 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["8 chicken drumsticks","½ cup cranberry sauce","2 tbsp soy sauce","1 tbsp olive oil","1 tsp garlic powder","steamed rice and veggies to serve"], method: ["Preheat oven to 200°C","Mix cranberry sauce, soy sauce, olive oil, garlic","Coat drumsticks in glaze","Bake 30 minutes, basting halfway","Serve with rice and steamed vegetables"], tags: ["nut-free","dairy-free","egg-free","gluten-free"] },
  { id: "kids-ne-beef-pot-pie", name: "Mini Beef Pot Pies", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "40 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["300g beef mince","1 carrot, diced","1 potato, cubed","½ cup frozen peas","1 cup stock","1 tbsp flour","1 sheet puff pastry","1 egg for glaze"], method: ["Brown mince, add carrot and potato, cook 5 min","Add flour, stir, pour in stock","Simmer 10 minutes until thickened, add peas","Divide among ramekins","Top with pastry circles, brush with egg","Bake at 200°C for 15 minutes until golden"], tags: ["nut-free"], image: "/images/recipes/meals/kids-ne-beef-pot-pie.png" },

  // ── HEALTHY PARENTS / HEALTHY KIDS-INSPIRED RECIPES ──
  { id: "kids-hp-bircher-cups", name: "Berry Bircher Cups", mealType: ["breakfast","lunch"], protein: "none", prepTime: "10 min + overnight", serves: 4, ingredients: ["2 cups rolled oats","1½ cups milk or plant milk","½ cup yoghurt","1 apple, grated","1 tbsp honey","1 cup mixed berries","1 tbsp chia seeds"], method: ["Mix oats, milk, yoghurt, grated apple, honey, chia","Divide among jars or cups","Refrigerate overnight","Top with mixed berries in the morning","Serve cold"], tags: ["vegetarian","nut-free","egg-free"] },
  { id: "kids-hp-zucchini-fritters", name: "Zucchini & Corn Fritters", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["2 zucchini, grated and squeezed dry","½ cup corn kernels","2 eggs","¼ cup flour","¼ cup feta, crumbled","1 spring onion, sliced","oil for frying"], method: ["Mix zucchini, corn, eggs, flour, feta, spring onion","Heat oil in pan","Drop spoonfuls of mixture, flatten slightly","Cook 3 minutes each side until golden","Serve with tomato sauce"], tags: ["vegetarian","nut-free"] },
  { id: "kids-hp-banana-pikelets", name: "Banana Pikelets", mealType: ["breakfast","lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "15 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["2 ripe bananas, mashed","2 eggs","½ cup flour","½ tsp baking powder","½ tsp cinnamon","butter for cooking"], method: ["Mash bananas, whisk in eggs","Add flour, baking powder, cinnamon","Cook small spoonfuls in buttered pan","2-3 minutes each side until golden","Serve with fruit or yoghurt"], tags: ["nut-free"] },
  { id: "kids-hp-chicken-schnitzel", name: "Oven-Baked Chicken Schnitzel", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["4 chicken breast fillets, pounded thin","1 cup panko breadcrumbs","½ cup flour","1 egg, beaten","1 tsp paprika","cooking spray","lemon wedges"], method: ["Preheat oven to 200°C","Mix breadcrumbs with paprika","Coat chicken in flour, dip in egg, press into breadcrumbs","Place on lined tray, spray with oil","Bake 18-20 minutes until golden and cooked through"], tags: ["nut-free","dairy-free"] },
  { id: "kids-hp-lamb-kofta", name: "Lamb Kofta with Yoghurt Dip", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["500g lamb mince","1 tsp cumin","1 tsp coriander","1 grated onion","1 egg","pita bread","cucumber yoghurt dip","lettuce and tomato"], method: ["Mix lamb, cumin, coriander, onion, egg","Form into oval shapes around skewers","Grill 4-5 min each side","Serve in pita with lettuce, tomato","Drizzle with yoghurt dip"], tags: ["nut-free"], image: "/images/recipes/meals/kids-hp-lamb-kofta.png" },
  { id: "kids-hp-veggie-fried-rice", name: "Rainbow Veggie Fried Rice", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "15 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["3 cups cold cooked rice","2 eggs, beaten","1 cup frozen mixed vegetables","1 carrot, diced","2 tbsp soy sauce","1 tbsp sesame oil","1 spring onion, sliced"], method: ["Scramble eggs in sesame oil, break up","Add vegetables, cook 3 minutes","Add rice and soy sauce, toss well","Cook until heated through","Top with spring onion"], tags: ["vegetarian","nut-free","dairy-free"] },
  { id: "kids-hp-tuna-patties", name: "Tuna & Sweet Potato Patties", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "fish", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["2 cans tuna, drained","1 sweet potato, cooked and mashed","1 egg","¼ cup breadcrumbs","1 tbsp lemon juice","2 tbsp fresh parsley","oil for frying"], method: ["Mix tuna, sweet potato, egg, breadcrumbs, lemon, parsley","Form into patties","Pan-fry in oil 3-4 minutes each side until golden","Serve with salad or in wraps"], tags: ["nut-free","dairy-free"] },
  { id: "kids-hp-pork-san-choy-bau", name: "Pork Lettuce Cups", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "pork", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g pork mince","1 carrot, finely diced","1 cup mushrooms, finely diced","2 tbsp hoisin sauce","1 tbsp soy sauce","1 tsp sesame oil","butter lettuce leaves","rice to serve"], method: ["Brown pork mince in sesame oil","Add carrot and mushrooms, cook 3 minutes","Add hoisin and soy sauce, toss","Spoon into lettuce leaves","Serve with steamed rice"], tags: ["nut-free","dairy-free","egg-free"], image: "/images/recipes/meals/kids-hp-pork-san-choy-bau.png" },
  { id: "kids-hp-chicken-noodle-soup", name: "Classic Chicken Noodle Soup", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["2 chicken breasts","6 cups chicken stock","2 carrots, sliced","2 celery stalks, sliced","1 cup small noodles","1 tbsp fresh parsley","salt and pepper"], method: ["Simmer chicken in stock 15 minutes until cooked","Remove chicken, shred with forks","Add carrots, celery, and noodles to stock","Cook until noodles are tender","Return shredded chicken, season, add parsley"], tags: ["nut-free","dairy-free","egg-free"], image: "/images/recipes/meals/kids-hp-chicken-noodle-soup.png" },
  { id: "kids-hp-beef-rissoles", name: "Classic Beef Rissoles", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["500g beef mince","1 onion, grated","1 carrot, grated","¼ cup breadcrumbs","1 egg","1 tbsp tomato sauce","1 tsp herbs","oil for frying"], method: ["Mix all ingredients except oil","Form into small patties","Pan-fry in oil 4-5 minutes each side","Serve with mashed potato and vegetables"], tags: ["nut-free","dairy-free"], image: "/images/recipes/meals/kids-hp-beef-rissoles.png" },
  { id: "kids-hp-fish-tacos", name: "Crispy Fish Tacos", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "fish", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g firm white fish","½ cup flour","1 egg","½ cup breadcrumbs","8 small tortillas","1 cup shredded cabbage","½ avocado, sliced","lime wedges"], method: ["Cut fish into strips","Coat in flour, egg, then breadcrumbs","Bake at 200°C for 12-15 minutes","Warm tortillas","Assemble with fish, cabbage, avocado, lime squeeze"], tags: ["nut-free"] },
  { id: "kids-hp-chicken-stir-fry", name: "Honey Chicken Stir Fry", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g chicken breast, sliced","1 broccoli, cut into florets","1 carrot, julienned","1 capsicum, sliced","2 tbsp soy sauce","1 tbsp honey","1 tsp sesame oil","2 cups rice"], method: ["Cook rice","Stir-fry chicken in sesame oil until golden","Add vegetables, cook 3 minutes","Add soy sauce and honey","Toss and serve over rice"], tags: ["nut-free","dairy-free","egg-free"] },
  { id: "kids-hp-veggie-pasta-bake", name: "Hidden Veggie Pasta Bake", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "cheese", prepTime: "35 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["300g penne pasta","1 carrot, grated","1 zucchini, grated","1 cup passata","½ cup ricotta","1 cup mozzarella, grated","1 tsp Italian herbs","¼ cup parmesan"], method: ["Cook pasta","Mix passata with grated vegetables and herbs","Layer pasta, sauce, dollops of ricotta","Top with mozzarella and parmesan","Bake at 180°C for 20 minutes until golden"], tags: ["vegetarian","nut-free","egg-free"] },
  { id: "kids-hp-sausage-tray-bake", name: "One-Tray Sausage & Veggie Bake", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "pork", prepTime: "35 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["8 pork sausages","2 sweet potatoes, cubed","1 capsicum, chunked","1 zucchini, chunked","1 red onion, wedged","2 tbsp olive oil","1 tsp paprika","salt and pepper"], method: ["Preheat oven to 200°C","Toss vegetables with oil, paprika, salt","Spread on large baking tray with sausages","Bake 30 minutes, turning sausages halfway","Serve with bread or rice"], tags: ["dairy-free","gluten-free","nut-free","egg-free"] },

  // Snacks (paleo-friendly, usable as lunch sides)
  { id: "kids-paleo-zucchini-fries", name: "Crispy Zucchini Fries", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["2 zucchini, cut into sticks","1 egg","¼ cup almond flour","1 tsp dried oregano","olive oil for frying","tomato sauce for dipping"], method: ["Whisk egg in one bowl","Mix almond flour and oregano in another","Dip zucchini in egg, then flour mixture","Shallow-fry in olive oil until golden on all sides","Drain and serve with tomato sauce"], tags: ["dairy-free","gluten-free"] },
  { id: "kids-paleo-cauliflower-bites", name: "Popcorn Cauliflower Bites", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "none", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["1 head cauliflower, broken into small florets","2 tbsp olive oil","1 tsp garlic powder","½ tsp paprika","½ tsp salt","ranch dip or guacamole"], method: ["Preheat oven to 220°C","Toss cauliflower with oil, garlic, paprika, salt","Spread on lined tray in single layer","Roast 20 minutes until golden and crispy","Serve with dip"], tags: ["vegan","dairy-free","gluten-free","nut-free","egg-free"] },

  // ── ANNABEL KARMEL: REAL FOOD KIDS WILL LOVE ──

  { id: "kids-ak-pasta-salad-pots", name: "Pasta Salad Pots", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "cheese", prepTime: "15 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["2 cups cooked pasta","½ cup cherry tomatoes, halved","½ cup cucumber, diced","¼ cup corn","50g feta, crumbled","2 tbsp olive oil","1 tbsp lemon juice"], method: ["Toss cooled pasta with vegetables","Add feta, olive oil, lemon juice","Season with salt and pepper","Divide into containers","Serve cold"], tags: ["vegetarian","nut-free","egg-free"] },

  // ── ANNABEL KARMEL: FINGER FOODS FOR BABIES AND TODDLERS ──

  // ── AMERICA'S TEST KITCHEN: COMPLETE COOKBOOK FOR TEEN CHEFS ──

  { id: "kids-aa-ants-on-a-log", name: "Ants on a Log", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "none", prepTime: "5 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["4 celery sticks","4 tbsp peanut butter or cream cheese","2 tbsp raisins"], method: ["Wash and cut celery into sticks","Fill the groove with peanut butter or cream cheese","Place raisins along the top like 'ants'","Serve immediately"], tags: ["vegetarian","egg-free","gluten-free"] },

  // ── AVA ARCHER: FINGER FOODS RECIPES FOR KIDS ──

  // ── HEATHER WISH STALLER: LITTLE HELPERS TODDLER COOKBOOK ──

  // ── OLIVIA RANA: HEALTHY N DELICIOUS SCHOOL LUNCH COOKBOOK ──

  { id: "kids-or-tuna-melt-pockets", name: "Tuna Melt Pockets", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "fish", prepTime: "15 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["1 can tuna, drained","½ cup grated cheese","2 tbsp mayo","4 pita pockets","½ cup corn","1 tbsp lemon juice"], method: ["Mix tuna, cheese, mayo, corn, lemon","Fill pita pockets with mixture","Toast in oven at 180°C for 8 minutes until cheese melts","Serve warm or cooled for lunchbox"], tags: ["nut-free"] },
  { id: "kids-or-pasta-muffins", name: "Savoury Pasta Muffins", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 6, ingredients: ["1½ cups cooked pasta","3 eggs","½ cup grated cheese","½ cup frozen peas","¼ cup milk","salt and pepper"], method: ["Preheat oven to 180°C","Whisk eggs with milk, salt, pepper","Fold in pasta, cheese, peas","Divide into greased muffin tin","Bake 18-20 minutes until set and golden"], tags: ["nut-free"] },

  // ── EMMA JANE FROST: HAMLYN 200 RECIPES FOR KIDS ──
  { id: "kids-ej-spaghetti-nests", name: "Spaghetti Nests with Meatballs", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["300g spaghetti","400g beef mince","¼ cup breadcrumbs","1 egg","1 jar passata","½ cup grated parmesan","1 tsp Italian herbs"], method: ["Mix mince, breadcrumbs, egg, herbs, form small balls","Brown meatballs, add passata, simmer 15 minutes","Cook spaghetti","Twirl spaghetti into nests on plates","Top with meatballs and sauce, sprinkle parmesan"], tags: ["nut-free"] },
```
