  { id: "kids-ej-traffic-light-peppers", name: "Traffic Light Stuffed Peppers", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "35 min", serves: 3, ingredients: ["1 red, 1 yellow, 1 green capsicum","300g beef mince","1 cup cooked rice","½ cup passata","½ cup grated cheese","1 tsp cumin"], method: ["Cut tops off capsicums, remove seeds","Brown mince with cumin, mix with rice and passata","Stuff capsicums with mixture","Top with cheese","Bake at 190°C for 25 minutes until tender"], tags: ["nut-free","egg-free","gluten-free"] },

  // ── SEAN COVEY-STYLE TEEN COOKING (7 HABITS INSPIRED) ──
  { id: "kids-sc-proactive-smoothie-bowl", name: "Proactive Power Smoothie Bowl", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "none", prepTime: "10 min", serves: 2, ingredients: ["2 frozen bananas","1 cup frozen berries","½ cup yoghurt","2 tbsp granola","1 tbsp honey","1 tbsp chia seeds","fresh fruit for topping"], method: ["Blend frozen banana and berries with yoghurt until thick","Pour into bowls","Top with granola, chia seeds, fresh fruit","Drizzle with honey","Serve immediately"], tags: ["vegetarian","nut-free","egg-free","gluten-free"] },

  // ── SARAH POUND: WHOLESOME BY SARAH ──
  { id: "kids-sp-one-pan-sausage-pasta", name: "One-Pan Sausage Pasta", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "pork", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["4 pork sausages, sliced","300g penne","1 jar passata","1 cup frozen peas","½ cup parmesan, grated","1 tsp Italian herbs","1 cup water"], method: ["Brown sausage slices in large pan","Add passata, water, herbs, bring to simmer","Add pasta, cover and cook 12-14 minutes stirring occasionally","Stir in peas, cook 2 more minutes","Top with parmesan"], tags: ["nut-free","egg-free"] },
  { id: "kids-sp-honey-soy-salmon", name: "15-Minute Honey Soy Salmon", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "fish", prepTime: "15 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["4 salmon fillets","2 tbsp soy sauce","1 tbsp honey","1 tsp garlic, minced","1 tsp sesame oil","2 cups rice","steamed greens to serve"], method: ["Mix soy sauce, honey, garlic, sesame oil","Pan-fry salmon skin-side down 4 minutes","Flip, spoon glaze over, cook 3 more minutes","Serve over rice with steamed greens"], tags: ["nut-free","dairy-free","egg-free","gluten-free"] },
  { id: "kids-sp-chicken-pesto-bake", name: "Chicken Pesto Tray Bake", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["4 chicken thighs","3 tbsp pesto","400g baby potatoes, halved","1 cup cherry tomatoes","1 zucchini, sliced","1 tbsp olive oil","salt"], method: ["Preheat oven to 200°C","Toss potatoes and zucchini with oil and salt on tray","Rub chicken with pesto, nestle among veggies","Add tomatoes","Bake 25-30 minutes until chicken is cooked through"], tags: ["nut-free","egg-free","gluten-free"] },
  { id: "kids-sp-creamy-tuscan-chicken", name: "Creamy Tuscan Chicken", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["4 chicken breasts, butterflied","1 cup sun-dried tomatoes, sliced","2 cups baby spinach","1 cup cream","½ cup parmesan, grated","2 cloves garlic, minced","1 tbsp olive oil"], method: ["Season and pan-fry chicken in olive oil until golden, set aside","Sauté garlic, add sun-dried tomatoes","Pour in cream, stir in parmesan until melted","Add spinach, wilt for 1 minute","Return chicken to pan, simmer 3 minutes"], tags: ["nut-free","egg-free","gluten-free"] },
  { id: "kids-sp-beef-stroganoff", name: "Quick Beef Stroganoff", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g beef strips","1 onion, sliced","200g mushrooms, sliced","1 cup sour cream","2 tbsp tomato paste","1 tsp paprika","300g egg noodles"], method: ["Cook noodles","Sear beef strips in hot pan, set aside","Sauté onion and mushrooms until soft","Add tomato paste, paprika, sour cream","Return beef, simmer 3 minutes, serve over noodles"], tags: ["nut-free"], image: "/images/recipes/meals/kids-sp-beef-stroganoff.png" },
  { id: "kids-sp-lemon-herb-fish", name: "Lemon Herb Baked Fish", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "fish", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["4 white fish fillets","2 tbsp butter, melted","1 lemon, juiced and zested","1 tsp dried dill","1 tsp garlic powder","salt and pepper","steamed veggies to serve"], method: ["Preheat oven to 200°C","Place fish on lined tray","Mix melted butter, lemon juice, zest, dill, garlic","Pour over fish","Bake 12-15 minutes, serve with steamed veggies"], tags: ["nut-free","egg-free","gluten-free"] },
  { id: "kids-sp-teriyaki-meatballs", name: "Teriyaki Meatballs", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["500g beef mince","¼ cup breadcrumbs","1 egg","3 tbsp soy sauce","2 tbsp honey","1 tsp ginger, grated","1 tsp sesame oil","2 cups rice","spring onion for garnish"], method: ["Mix mince, breadcrumbs, egg, form balls","Brown in pan on all sides","Mix soy, honey, ginger, sesame oil","Pour sauce over meatballs, simmer 8 minutes","Serve over rice, garnish with spring onion"], tags: ["nut-free","dairy-free"] },
  { id: "kids-sp-chicken-quesadillas", name: "Speedy Chicken Quesadillas", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "15 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["2 cups cooked shredded chicken","1½ cups grated cheese","4 large tortillas","½ cup corn","½ capsicum, diced","2 tbsp sour cream"], method: ["Layer cheese, chicken, corn, capsicum on half of each tortilla","Fold in half","Cook in dry pan 2-3 minutes each side until golden","Cut into wedges","Serve with sour cream"], tags: ["nut-free","egg-free"], image: "/images/recipes/meals/kids-sp-chicken-quesadillas.png" },
  { id: "kids-sp-pumpkin-soup", name: "Wholesome Pumpkin Soup", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "none", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 6, ingredients: ["1 kg pumpkin, peeled and cubed","1 onion, diced","2 cloves garlic","4 cups chicken stock","½ cup cream","1 tbsp olive oil","crusty bread to serve"], method: ["Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil","Add pumpkin and stock, bring to boil","Simmer 20 minutes until pumpkin is tender","Blend until smooth, stir in cream","Serve with crusty bread"], tags: ["nut-free","egg-free","gluten-free"] },
  { id: "kids-sp-sticky-chicken-drumsticks", name: "Sticky Chicken Drumsticks", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "40 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["8 chicken drumsticks","3 tbsp soy sauce","2 tbsp honey","1 tbsp tomato sauce","1 tsp garlic powder","1 tsp sesame seeds"], method: ["Preheat oven to 200°C","Mix soy, honey, tomato sauce, garlic powder","Coat drumsticks in sauce","Bake 35 minutes, basting halfway","Sprinkle sesame seeds, serve with rice and veggies"], tags: ["nut-free","dairy-free","egg-free"] },
  { id: "kids-sp-one-pot-bolognese", name: "One-Pot Hidden Veggie Bolognese", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["500g beef mince","1 carrot, grated","1 zucchini, grated","1 cup mushrooms, finely diced","1 jar passata","1 tsp Italian herbs","300g spaghetti","parmesan to serve"], method: ["Brown mince in large pot","Add grated veggies and mushrooms, cook 3 minutes","Add passata, herbs, simmer 10 minutes","Cook spaghetti, toss with sauce","Serve with parmesan"], tags: ["nut-free"] },
  { id: "kids-sp-lamb-cutlets", name: "Simple Herb Lamb Cutlets", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["8 lamb cutlets","2 tbsp olive oil","1 tbsp rosemary, chopped","2 cloves garlic, minced","salt and pepper","mashed potato to serve","steamed green beans"], method: ["Mix olive oil, rosemary, garlic, salt, pepper","Rub over lamb cutlets","Pan-fry or grill 3-4 minutes each side for medium","Rest 3 minutes","Serve with mash and green beans"], tags: ["nut-free","dairy-free","egg-free","gluten-free"], image: "/images/recipes/meals/kids-sp-lamb-cutlets.png" },
  { id: "kids-sp-chicken-fried-rice", name: "Weeknight Chicken Fried Rice", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "15 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["200g chicken breast, diced","3 cups cold cooked rice","2 eggs, beaten","1 cup frozen peas and corn","2 tbsp soy sauce","1 tbsp sesame oil","1 spring onion, sliced"], method: ["Cook chicken in sesame oil, set aside","Scramble eggs, break into pieces","Add rice, veggies, chicken","Add soy sauce, toss well","Garnish with spring onion"], tags: ["nut-free","dairy-free"] },
  { id: "kids-sp-cheesy-meatball-bake", name: "Cheesy Meatball Pasta Bake", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "35 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["500g beef mince","¼ cup breadcrumbs","1 egg","300g penne, cooked","1 jar passata","1½ cups grated mozzarella","1 tsp Italian herbs"], method: ["Mix mince, breadcrumbs, egg, herbs, form small balls","Brown meatballs, place in baking dish","Add cooked pasta and passata, mix","Top with mozzarella","Bake at 190°C for 20 minutes until golden"], tags: ["nut-free"] },
  { id: "kids-sp-salmon-patties", name: "Crispy Salmon Patties", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "fish", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["2 cans salmon, drained","1 egg","¼ cup breadcrumbs","1 spring onion, sliced","1 tbsp lemon juice","½ tsp dill","oil for frying","tartare sauce to serve"], method: ["Mix salmon, egg, breadcrumbs, spring onion, lemon, dill","Form into 8 patties","Pan-fry in oil 3-4 minutes each side until golden","Drain on paper towels","Serve with tartare sauce and salad"], tags: ["nut-free","dairy-free"] },
  { id: "kids-sp-chicken-schnitzel", name: "Golden Chicken Schnitzel", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["4 chicken breasts, butterflied","1 cup breadcrumbs","½ cup flour","2 eggs, beaten","½ tsp garlic powder","oil for frying","lemon wedges"], method: ["Season flour with garlic powder","Coat chicken: flour, egg, breadcrumbs","Shallow-fry 4-5 minutes each side until golden","Drain on paper towels","Serve with lemon wedges, chips, and salad"], tags: ["nut-free","dairy-free"] },

  // ── SARAH POUND: FAST WEEKNIGHT DINNER IDEAS ──
  { id: "kids-sp-butter-chicken", name: "Easy Butter Chicken", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g chicken thigh, cubed","1 onion, diced","2 cloves garlic, minced","1 cup passata","1 cup cream","2 tbsp butter","1 tbsp mild curry powder","½ tsp turmeric","2 cups rice"], method: ["Cook rice","Sauté onion and garlic in butter","Add chicken, cook 5 minutes","Add curry powder, turmeric, passata","Simmer 10 minutes, stir in cream","Serve over rice"], tags: ["nut-free","egg-free","gluten-free"] },
  { id: "kids-sp-pork-stir-fry", name: "Sweet Chilli Pork Stir Fry", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "pork", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g pork loin, sliced","1 capsicum, sliced","1 cup broccoli florets","1 carrot, julienned","3 tbsp sweet chilli sauce","1 tbsp soy sauce","2 cups rice noodles"], method: ["Cook rice noodles","Stir-fry pork until golden, set aside","Add veggies, cook 3 minutes","Return pork, add sweet chilli and soy","Toss with noodles and serve"], tags: ["nut-free","dairy-free","egg-free"], image: "/images/recipes/meals/kids-sp-pork-stir-fry.png" },
  { id: "kids-sp-fish-pie", name: "Comforting Fish Pie", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "fish", prepTime: "40 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g mixed fish (salmon, cod), cubed","4 potatoes, peeled and cubed","1 cup frozen peas","1 cup milk","2 tbsp butter","2 tbsp flour","1 cup grated cheese"], method: ["Boil and mash potatoes with butter and milk","Make white sauce: melt butter, whisk flour, add milk","Add fish and peas to sauce, pour into baking dish","Top with mashed potato and cheese","Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden"], tags: ["nut-free","egg-free"], image: "/images/recipes/meals/kids-sp-fish-pie.png" },
  { id: "kids-sp-taco-night", name: "Build-Your-Own Tacos", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g beef mince","1 tsp cumin","1 tsp paprika","½ tsp garlic powder","8 taco shells","shredded lettuce, diced tomato, grated cheese","sour cream and salsa"], method: ["Brown mince, add cumin, paprika, garlic","Simmer 5 minutes with splash of water","Warm taco shells","Set out all toppings","Let everyone build their own tacos"], tags: ["nut-free","egg-free","gluten-free"] },
  { id: "kids-sp-chicken-noodle-soup", name: "Chicken Noodle Soup", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["2 chicken breasts","200g egg noodles","2 carrots, sliced","2 celery sticks, sliced","1 onion, diced","4 cups chicken stock","1 tbsp olive oil","salt and pepper"], method: ["Sauté onion, carrot, celery in olive oil","Add stock, bring to boil","Add chicken, simmer until cooked, shred","Cook noodles separately, add to soup","Season and serve hot"], tags: ["nut-free","dairy-free"], image: "/images/recipes/meals/kids-sp-chicken-noodle-soup.png" },
  { id: "kids-sp-chilli-con-carne", name: "Mild Chilli Con Carne", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["500g beef mince","1 can kidney beans, drained","1 can diced tomatoes","1 capsicum, diced","1 tsp cumin","½ tsp mild chilli powder","2 cups rice","sour cream and cheese to serve"], method: ["Brown mince, drain fat","Add capsicum, cook 2 minutes","Add tomatoes, beans, cumin, chilli","Simmer 15 minutes","Serve over rice with sour cream and cheese"], tags: ["nut-free","egg-free","gluten-free"] },
  { id: "kids-sp-chicken-burgers", name: "Homemade Chicken Burgers", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g chicken mince","¼ cup breadcrumbs","1 spring onion, sliced","1 tsp garlic powder","4 burger buns","lettuce, tomato, cheese","mayo and tomato sauce"], method: ["Mix mince, breadcrumbs, spring onion, garlic","Form into 4 patties","Pan-fry or grill 5 minutes each side","Toast buns, assemble with lettuce, tomato, cheese","Add mayo and tomato sauce"], tags: ["nut-free"], image: "/images/recipes/meals/kids-sp-chicken-burgers.png" },
  { id: "kids-sp-carbonara", name: "15-Minute Carbonara", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "pork", prepTime: "15 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["300g spaghetti","150g bacon, diced","3 eggs","½ cup parmesan, grated","1 clove garlic, minced","salt and pepper"], method: ["Cook spaghetti","Fry bacon until crispy, add garlic","Whisk eggs with parmesan","Toss hot pasta with bacon","Remove from heat, stir through egg mixture quickly","Season with pepper"], tags: ["nut-free"] },
  { id: "kids-sp-greek-lamb-bowls", name: "Greek Lamb Rice Bowls", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g lamb mince","1 tsp oregano","1 tsp garlic powder","½ tsp cumin","2 cups rice","½ cup tzatziki","1 cucumber, diced","1 tomato, diced","½ red onion, sliced"], method: ["Cook rice","Brown lamb mince with oregano, garlic, cumin","Build bowls: rice, lamb, cucumber, tomato, onion","Dollop tzatziki on top","Serve immediately"], tags: ["nut-free","egg-free"], image: "/images/recipes/meals/kids-sp-greek-lamb-bowls.png" },
  { id: "kids-sp-veggie-frittata", name: "Loaded Veggie Frittata", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["8 eggs","½ cup milk","1 cup grated cheese","1 cup diced capsicum","1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved","1 cup baby spinach","salt and pepper"], method: ["Preheat oven to 180°C","Whisk eggs, milk, half the cheese, season","Layer veggies in greased oven-safe pan","Pour egg mixture over","Top with remaining cheese","Bake 20 minutes until set and golden"], tags: ["nut-free","gluten-free","vegetarian"] },
  { id: "kids-sp-honey-mustard-chicken", name: "Honey Mustard Chicken Thighs", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "35 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["8 chicken thighs","2 tbsp honey","2 tbsp wholegrain mustard","1 tbsp olive oil","1 tsp garlic powder","400g baby potatoes, halved","1 cup green beans"], method: ["Preheat oven to 200°C","Mix honey, mustard, oil, garlic","Toss chicken and potatoes in sauce","Bake 25 minutes","Add green beans, bake 10 more minutes","Serve immediately"], tags: ["nut-free","dairy-free","egg-free","gluten-free"] },
  { id: "kids-sp-tuna-pasta", name: "Creamy Tuna Pasta", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "fish", prepTime: "15 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["300g penne","2 cans tuna, drained","½ cup cream","½ cup frozen peas","½ cup parmesan, grated","1 lemon, juiced","salt and pepper"], method: ["Cook penne","Warm cream in same pot with peas","Add tuna, lemon juice, parmesan","Toss with pasta","Season and serve"], tags: ["nut-free"] },
  { id: "kids-sp-sausage-tray-bake", name: "Sausage & Veggie Tray Bake", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "pork", prepTime: "35 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["8 pork sausages","400g baby potatoes, halved","1 red onion, quartered","1 capsicum, chunked","1 zucchini, chunked","2 tbsp olive oil","1 tsp mixed herbs"], method: ["Preheat oven to 200°C","Toss all veggies with oil and herbs on large tray","Nestle sausages among veggies","Bake 30-35 minutes, turning sausages halfway","Serve with mustard or tomato sauce"], tags: ["nut-free","dairy-free","egg-free","gluten-free"] },
  { id: "kids-sp-nachos", name: "Loaded Beef Nachos", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g beef mince","1 tsp cumin","½ tsp paprika","1 bag corn chips","1 cup grated cheese","½ cup salsa","½ avocado, diced","sour cream"], method: ["Brown mince with cumin and paprika","Spread corn chips on baking tray","Top with mince and cheese","Bake at 190°C for 8 minutes until cheese melts","Top with salsa, avocado, sour cream"], tags: ["nut-free","egg-free","gluten-free"], image: "/images/recipes/meals/kids-sp-nachos.png" },

  // ── DANIELLE KARTES: MY VERY FIRST COOKBOOK ──
  { id: "kids-dk-pb-banana-bites", name: "PB Banana Roll-Ups", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "none", prepTime: "5 min", serves: 2, ingredients: ["2 flour tortillas","3 tbsp peanut butter","2 bananas","1 tbsp honey","pinch cinnamon"], method: ["Spread peanut butter on tortillas","Place banana at edge, drizzle with honey and cinnamon","Roll up tightly","Slice into bite-size rounds","Serve immediately or pack for lunch"], tags: ["vegetarian","dairy-free","egg-free"] },
  { id: "kids-dk-confetti-rice", name: "Confetti Rice Bowl", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "15 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["2 cups cooked rice","2 eggs, scrambled","½ cup corn","½ cup diced capsicum","½ cup frozen peas","2 tbsp soy sauce","1 tbsp butter"], method: ["Scramble eggs in butter, break into pieces","Add rice, corn, capsicum, peas","Toss with soy sauce over high heat 3 minutes","Serve in colorful bowls"], tags: ["nut-free"] },
  { id: "kids-dk-dippable-chicken", name: "Dippable Chicken Tenders", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g chicken breast, sliced into tenders","1 cup breadcrumbs","½ cup flour","1 egg, beaten","½ tsp onion powder","cooking spray","honey mustard and ketchup for dipping"], method: ["Preheat oven to 200°C","Mix breadcrumbs with onion powder","Coat chicken: flour, egg, breadcrumbs","Bake on lined tray 15-18 minutes","Serve with dipping sauces"], tags: ["nut-free","dairy-free"] },

  // ── KIM MCCOSKER: 4 INGREDIENTS KIDS ──
  { id: "kids-km-ham-cheese-scrolls", name: "4-Ingredient Ham & Cheese Scrolls", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "pork", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 8, ingredients: ["1 sheet puff pastry","4 slices ham","1 cup grated cheese","1 tbsp tomato paste"], method: ["Spread tomato paste on pastry","Layer ham and sprinkle cheese","Roll up tightly, slice into 8 rounds","Place cut-side up on lined tray","Bake at 200°C for 15 minutes until golden"], tags: ["nut-free"] },
  { id: "kids-km-corn-fritters", name: "Simple Corn Fritters", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "15 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["2 cups corn kernels","2 eggs","¼ cup flour","oil for frying"], method: ["Mix corn, eggs, flour together","Heat oil in pan","Drop spoonfuls, flatten slightly","Cook 2-3 minutes each side until golden","Serve with sweet chilli sauce"], tags: ["vegetarian","nut-free","dairy-free"] },
  { id: "kids-km-choc-banana-pops", name: "Frozen Choc-Banana Pops", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "none", prepTime: "10 min + freeze", serves: 4, ingredients: ["4 bananas","200g dark chocolate, melted","sprinkles or crushed rice bubbles"], method: ["Insert popsicle sticks into banana halves","Dip in melted chocolate","Roll in sprinkles or rice bubbles","Place on baking paper on a tray","Freeze 2 hours until solid"], tags: ["vegan","dairy-free","egg-free","nut-free","gluten-free"] },

  // ── SARAH WILSON: HEALTHY FAMILY MEALS ──
  { id: "kids-sw-veggie-loaded-mince", name: "Veggie-Loaded Mince", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g beef mince","1 carrot, grated","1 zucchini, grated","½ cup mushrooms, finely diced","1 cup passata","1 tsp cumin","rice or pasta to serve"], method: ["Brown mince in pan","Add all grated vegetables and mushrooms, cook 5 minutes","Add passata and cumin, simmer 10 minutes","Serve over rice or pasta"], tags: ["nut-free","dairy-free","egg-free","gluten-free"] },
  { id: "kids-sw-salmon-rice-balls", name: "Salmon & Rice Balls", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "fish", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["1 can salmon, drained","1½ cups cooked rice","1 egg","¼ cup breadcrumbs","1 tbsp lemon juice","1 tbsp fresh dill","oil for frying"], method: ["Mix salmon, rice, egg, breadcrumbs, lemon, dill","Form into small balls","Pan-fry in oil until golden all over","Drain on paper towel","Serve with salad or in wraps"], tags: ["nut-free","dairy-free"] },
  { id: "kids-sw-chicken-veggie-soup", name: "Healing Chicken Veggie Soup", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["2 chicken breasts","6 cups chicken stock","2 carrots, diced","1 sweet potato, cubed","2 celery stalks, sliced","1 cup baby spinach","salt and pepper"], method: ["Simmer chicken in stock 15 minutes","Remove and shred chicken","Add carrots, sweet potato, celery, cook until tender","Return chicken, add spinach","Season and serve"], tags: ["nut-free","dairy-free","egg-free","gluten-free"] },

  // ── DANIELLE FAHRENKRUG: DAIRY FREE COOKBOOK FOR KIDS ──
  { id: "kids-df-chicken-satay-bowls", name: "Dairy-Free Chicken Satay Bowls", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g chicken breast, sliced","3 tbsp peanut butter","2 tbsp soy sauce","1 tbsp lime juice","1 tsp honey","1 carrot, julienned","1 cucumber, sliced","2 cups rice"], method: ["Mix peanut butter, soy sauce, lime, honey with 2 tbsp warm water","Pan-fry chicken until golden","Toss with half the satay sauce","Serve over rice with carrot, cucumber","Drizzle remaining sauce"], tags: ["dairy-free","egg-free"], image: "/images/recipes/meals/kids-df-chicken-satay-bowls.png" },
  { id: "kids-df-banana-pancakes", name: "Dairy-Free Fluffy Pancakes", mealType: ["breakfast","lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "15 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["1½ cups flour","1 cup oat milk","1 egg","2 tbsp maple syrup","2 tsp baking powder","1 tbsp coconut oil","berries to serve"], method: ["Mix flour and baking powder","Whisk oat milk, egg, maple syrup separately","Combine wet and dry","Cook in coconut oil 2-3 min each side","Serve with berries"], tags: ["dairy-free","nut-free"] },
  { id: "kids-df-spaghetti-meatballs", name: "Dairy-Free Spaghetti & Meatballs", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["500g beef mince","¼ cup breadcrumbs","1 egg","1 tsp Italian herbs","1 jar passata","300g spaghetti","nutritional yeast to serve"], method: ["Mix mince, breadcrumbs, egg, herbs, form balls","Brown in pan, add passata, simmer 15 minutes","Cook spaghetti","Serve meatballs and sauce over spaghetti","Sprinkle nutritional yeast"], tags: ["dairy-free","nut-free"] },

  // ── KELLI & PETER BRONSKI: KIDS COOK GLUTEN-FREE ──
  { id: "kids-gf-chicken-tenders", name: "GF Crispy Chicken Tenders", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g chicken breast, sliced","1 cup rice flour","1 egg, beaten","1 cup gluten-free breadcrumbs","½ tsp garlic powder","½ tsp paprika","cooking spray"], method: ["Preheat oven to 200°C","Mix breadcrumbs with garlic and paprika","Coat chicken: rice flour, egg, breadcrumbs","Spray with oil, bake 15-18 minutes","Serve with honey mustard"], tags: ["gluten-free","nut-free","dairy-free"] },
  { id: "kids-gf-banana-bread", name: "GF Banana Bread", mealType: ["breakfast","lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "50 min", serves: 8, ingredients: ["3 ripe bananas","2 eggs","⅓ cup coconut oil, melted","¼ cup honey","2 cups almond flour","1 tsp baking soda","1 tsp cinnamon","pinch salt"], method: ["Preheat oven to 175°C","Mash bananas, mix with eggs, oil, honey","Add almond flour, baking soda, cinnamon, salt","Pour into greased loaf tin","Bake 40-45 minutes until skewer comes out clean"], tags: ["gluten-free","dairy-free"] },
  { id: "kids-gf-pizza-bites", name: "GF Pizza Bites", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "cheese", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 6, ingredients: ["2 cups gluten-free flour","1 tsp baking powder","¾ cup milk","2 tbsp olive oil","½ cup pizza sauce","1 cup grated mozzarella","pepperoni or veggies"], method: ["Mix flour, baking powder, milk, oil into soft dough","Press into greased mini muffin tin","Add sauce, cheese, toppings","Bake at 190°C for 15-18 minutes","Cool slightly before serving"], tags: ["gluten-free","nut-free","egg-free"] },

  // ── SAM DILLARD: THE KETO KIDS COOKBOOK ──
  { id: "kids-keto-cheese-crisps", name: "Keto Cheese Crisps", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "cheese", prepTime: "15 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["2 cups shredded cheddar","½ tsp garlic powder","½ tsp paprika"], method: ["Preheat oven to 200°C","Place small cheese mounds on lined tray","Sprinkle with garlic and paprika","Bake 8-10 minutes until golden and crispy","Cool completely — they crisp up as they cool"], tags: ["gluten-free","nut-free","egg-free","keto"] },
  { id: "kids-keto-chicken-nuggets", name: "Keto Almond-Crusted Chicken Nuggets", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g chicken breast, cubed","1 cup almond flour","½ cup parmesan, grated","1 egg, beaten","½ tsp garlic powder","½ tsp onion powder","cooking spray"], method: ["Preheat oven to 200°C","Mix almond flour, parmesan, garlic, onion powder","Dip chicken in egg, press into coating","Bake 15-18 minutes until golden","Serve with sugar-free ketchup"], tags: ["gluten-free","keto"] },
  { id: "kids-keto-zucchini-boats", name: "Keto Taco Zucchini Boats", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["4 large zucchini, halved lengthwise","300g beef mince","1 tsp cumin","½ tsp chilli powder","½ cup passata","1 cup grated cheese","sour cream to serve"], method: ["Scoop out zucchini centres to make boats","Brown mince with cumin and chilli","Add passata, simmer 5 minutes","Fill zucchini boats with mince mixture","Top with cheese, bake at 190°C for 20 minutes"], tags: ["gluten-free","nut-free","egg-free","keto"] },
  { id: "kids-keto-pepperoni-cups", name: "Keto Pepperoni Pizza Cups", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "cheese", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 6, ingredients: ["24 pepperoni slices","½ cup pizza sauce","1 cup shredded mozzarella","¼ cup mini capsicum, diced","Italian herbs"], method: ["Preheat oven to 190°C","Press pepperoni slices into mini muffin tin","Add 1 tsp pizza sauce to each","Top with cheese and capsicum","Bake 12-15 minutes until cheese bubbles"], tags: ["gluten-free","nut-free","egg-free","keto"] },
  { id: "kids-keto-cauliflower-mac", name: "Keto Cauliflower Mac & Cheese", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "cheese", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["1 large cauliflower, cut into florets","1 cup cream cheese","1 cup shredded cheddar","¼ cup butter","½ tsp mustard powder","pinch paprika"], method: ["Steam cauliflower until just tender","Melt butter, cream cheese, cheddar in saucepan","Add mustard powder, stir until smooth","Pour sauce over cauliflower","Bake at 180°C for 10 minutes until golden"], tags: ["gluten-free","nut-free","egg-free","keto","vegetarian"] },
  { id: "kids-keto-bacon-egg-cups", name: "Keto Bacon & Egg Cups", mealType: ["breakfast","lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 6, ingredients: ["6 bacon rashers","6 eggs","½ cup shredded cheese","salt and pepper","chives for garnish"], method: ["Preheat oven to 190°C","Line muffin tin cups with bacon strips","Crack an egg into each cup","Top with cheese, salt, pepper","Bake 15-18 minutes until eggs set","Garnish with chives"], tags: ["gluten-free","nut-free","keto"] },
  { id: "kids-keto-meatball-bake", name: "Keto Cheesy Meatball Bake", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "35 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["500g beef mince","½ cup almond flour","1 egg","1 tsp Italian herbs","1 cup passata","1½ cups shredded mozzarella","fresh basil"], method: ["Mix mince, almond flour, egg, herbs, form balls","Brown meatballs in pan","Place in baking dish, pour passata over","Top with mozzarella","Bake at 190°C for 20 minutes","Garnish with basil"], tags: ["gluten-free","keto"] },
  { id: "kids-keto-ham-pinwheels", name: "Keto Ham & Cheese Pinwheels", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "pork", prepTime: "15 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["8 slices ham","200g cream cheese, softened","1 cup shredded cheddar","¼ cup diced pickles","1 tbsp mustard"], method: ["Spread cream cheese over ham slices","Sprinkle cheddar and pickles","Add a line of mustard","Roll up tightly and chill 10 minutes","Slice into pinwheels and serve"], tags: ["gluten-free","nut-free","egg-free","keto"] },
  { id: "kids-keto-avocado-fries", name: "Keto Avocado Fries", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["2 avocados, sliced into wedges","½ cup almond flour","½ cup parmesan, grated","1 egg, beaten","½ tsp garlic powder","lime wedges"], method: ["Preheat oven to 200°C","Mix almond flour, parmesan, garlic powder","Dip avocado in egg, then coating","Bake on lined tray 12-15 minutes","Serve with lime wedges"], tags: ["gluten-free","keto","vegetarian"] },
  { id: "kids-keto-chicken-tenders", name: "Keto Parmesan Chicken Tenders", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g chicken breast, sliced","¾ cup almond flour","½ cup parmesan, grated","1 egg, beaten","½ tsp paprika","½ tsp onion powder","garlic aioli to serve"], method: ["Preheat oven to 200°C","Mix almond flour, parmesan, paprika, onion powder","Dip chicken in egg, press into coating","Bake 15-18 minutes until golden","Serve with garlic aioli"], tags: ["gluten-free","keto"] },
  { id: "kids-keto-sausage-balls", name: "Keto Sausage Cheese Balls", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "pork", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 6, ingredients: ["500g pork sausage meat","1½ cups shredded cheddar","¾ cup almond flour","1 egg","½ tsp garlic powder","½ tsp onion powder"], method: ["Preheat oven to 190°C","Mix all ingredients until combined","Roll into 24 small balls","Place on lined baking tray","Bake 18-20 minutes until golden brown"], tags: ["gluten-free","keto"] },
  { id: "kids-keto-tuna-melts", name: "Keto Tuna Melt Capsicums", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "fish", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["2 cans tuna, drained","¼ cup mayo","1 tbsp lemon juice","4 mini capsicums, halved","1 cup shredded cheddar","salt and pepper"], method: ["Mix tuna, mayo, lemon juice, salt, pepper","Fill capsicum halves with tuna mixture","Top generously with cheese","Bake at 190°C for 12-15 minutes","Serve warm"], tags: ["gluten-free","nut-free","egg-free","keto"] },
  { id: "kids-keto-butter-chicken", name: "Keto Mild Butter Chicken", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g chicken thigh, cubed","1 cup cream","½ cup passata","2 tbsp butter","1 tsp mild curry powder","½ tsp turmeric","½ tsp ginger powder","cauliflower rice to serve"], method: ["Cook chicken in butter until golden","Add curry powder, turmeric, ginger, cook 1 minute","Add passata and cream, simmer 15 minutes","Serve over cauliflower rice"], tags: ["gluten-free","nut-free","egg-free","keto"] },

  // ── MORE DAIRY FREE: DANIELLE FAHRENKRUG ──
  { id: "kids-df-chicken-tenders", name: "DF Coconut Chicken Tenders", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g chicken breast, sliced","1 cup shredded coconut","½ cup breadcrumbs","1 egg, beaten","½ tsp garlic powder","honey mustard dip (dairy-free)"], method: ["Preheat oven to 200°C","Mix coconut and breadcrumbs with garlic powder","Dip chicken in egg, press into coating","Bake 15-18 minutes until golden","Serve with dairy-free honey mustard"], tags: ["dairy-free","nut-free"] },
  { id: "kids-df-fried-rice", name: "DF Rainbow Fried Rice", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "15 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["3 cups cold cooked rice","2 eggs, beaten","1 cup frozen peas and corn","1 carrot, finely diced","2 tbsp soy sauce","1 tbsp sesame oil","1 spring onion, sliced"], method: ["Heat sesame oil, scramble eggs, set aside","Add carrot, peas, corn, cook 2 minutes","Add rice, soy sauce, toss well","Fold in scrambled eggs","Garnish with spring onion"], tags: ["dairy-free","nut-free"] },
  { id: "kids-df-pasta-bolognese", name: "DF Classic Bolognese", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["500g beef mince","1 jar passata","1 carrot, grated","1 zucchini, grated","1 tsp Italian herbs","300g spaghetti","nutritional yeast"], method: ["Brown mince, add grated veggies","Add passata and herbs, simmer 20 minutes","Cook spaghetti","Serve sauce over pasta","Sprinkle nutritional yeast"], tags: ["dairy-free","nut-free"] },
  { id: "kids-df-fish-tacos", name: "DF Crispy Fish Tacos", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "fish", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g white fish fillets","½ cup breadcrumbs","1 tsp paprika","8 small corn tortillas","1 cup shredded cabbage","1 avocado, sliced","lime wedges"], method: ["Coat fish in breadcrumbs with paprika","Bake at 200°C for 12-15 minutes","Warm tortillas","Fill with fish, cabbage, avocado","Squeeze lime over top"], tags: ["dairy-free","nut-free","egg-free"] },
  { id: "kids-df-meatball-sub", name: "DF Meatball Subs", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["500g beef mince","¼ cup breadcrumbs","1 egg","1 tsp garlic powder","1 jar passata","4 sub rolls","dairy-free cheese (optional)"], method: ["Mix mince, breadcrumbs, egg, garlic, form balls","Brown in pan, add passata, simmer 15 minutes","Split sub rolls, fill with meatballs and sauce","Top with dairy-free cheese if desired","Serve immediately"], tags: ["dairy-free","nut-free"] },
  { id: "kids-df-teriyaki-salmon", name: "DF Teriyaki Salmon Bites", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "fish", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g salmon fillet, cubed","3 tbsp soy sauce","1 tbsp maple syrup","1 tsp ginger, grated","2 cups rice","steamed broccoli"], method: ["Mix soy sauce, maple syrup, ginger","Marinate salmon 10 minutes","Pan-fry salmon until golden and cooked through","Serve over rice with broccoli","Drizzle remaining sauce"], tags: ["dairy-free","nut-free","egg-free","gluten-free"] },
  { id: "kids-df-chicken-noodle-soup", name: "DF Chicken Noodle Soup", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["2 chicken breasts","200g egg noodles","1 carrot, sliced","2 celery sticks, sliced","4 cups chicken stock (dairy-free)","1 tbsp olive oil","salt and pepper"], method: ["Simmer chicken in stock until cooked, shred","Cook noodles separately","Sauté carrot and celery in olive oil","Add stock, chicken, noodles","Season and serve hot"], tags: ["dairy-free","nut-free"], image: "/images/recipes/meals/kids-df-chicken-noodle-soup.png" },
  { id: "kids-df-pork-stir-fry", name: "DF Honey Pork Stir Fry", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "pork", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["300g pork loin, sliced","1 capsicum, sliced","1 cup broccoli florets","2 tbsp soy sauce","1 tbsp honey","1 tsp sesame oil","2 cups rice"], method: ["Cook rice","Stir-fry pork in sesame oil until golden","Add capsicum and broccoli, cook 3 minutes","Add soy sauce and honey, toss","Serve over rice"], tags: ["dairy-free","nut-free","egg-free"], image: "/images/recipes/meals/kids-df-pork-stir-fry.png" },
  { id: "kids-df-taco-bowls", name: "DF Taco Rice Bowls", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g beef mince","1 tsp cumin","½ tsp paprika","2 cups rice","1 cup corn","1 avocado, diced","½ cup salsa","shredded lettuce"], method: ["Brown mince with cumin and paprika","Cook rice","Build bowls: rice, mince, corn, lettuce","Top with avocado and salsa"], tags: ["dairy-free","nut-free","egg-free","gluten-free"] },
  { id: "kids-df-chicken-skewers", name: "DF Lemon Herb Chicken Skewers", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g chicken breast, cubed","2 tbsp olive oil","1 tbsp lemon juice","1 tsp oregano","1 tsp garlic powder","1 capsicum, chunked","1 zucchini, chunked"], method: ["Mix olive oil, lemon, oregano, garlic","Toss chicken and veggies in marinade","Thread onto skewers","Grill or bake at 200°C for 15 minutes","Serve with rice or flatbread"], tags: ["dairy-free","nut-free","egg-free","gluten-free"] },
  { id: "kids-df-veggie-curry", name: "DF Coconut Veggie Curry", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "tofu", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["200g firm tofu, cubed","1 can coconut milk","1 sweet potato, cubed","1 cup green beans","1 tsp mild curry powder","½ tsp turmeric","2 cups rice"], method: ["Cook rice","Sauté sweet potato in oil 5 minutes","Add coconut milk, curry powder, turmeric","Add green beans and tofu, simmer 15 minutes","Serve over rice"], tags: ["dairy-free","nut-free","egg-free","gluten-free","vegan"] },

  // ── MORE GLUTEN FREE: KELLI & PETER BRONSKI ──
  { id: "kids-gf-mac-cheese", name: "GF Mac & Cheese", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "cheese", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["300g gluten-free macaroni","2 cups shredded cheddar","1 cup milk","2 tbsp butter","2 tbsp rice flour","½ tsp mustard powder","pinch paprika"], method: ["Cook GF macaroni","Melt butter, whisk in rice flour","Gradually add milk, stir until thick","Add cheese and mustard, stir until smooth","Combine with pasta, serve with paprika"], tags: ["gluten-free","nut-free","egg-free"] },
  { id: "kids-gf-fish-fingers", name: "GF Crunchy Fish Fingers", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "fish", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g firm white fish, sliced into strips","1 cup rice flour","1 egg, beaten","1 cup GF cornflake crumbs","½ tsp garlic powder","lemon wedges"], method: ["Preheat oven to 200°C","Coat fish: rice flour, egg, cornflake crumbs with garlic","Bake on lined tray 15 minutes until golden","Serve with lemon wedges"], tags: ["gluten-free","nut-free","dairy-free"] },
  { id: "kids-gf-chicken-drumsticks", name: "GF Sticky Drumsticks", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "40 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["8 chicken drumsticks","3 tbsp tamari","2 tbsp honey","1 tbsp olive oil","1 tsp garlic powder","1 tsp smoked paprika"], method: ["Mix tamari, honey, oil, garlic, paprika","Coat drumsticks in mixture","Bake at 200°C for 35 minutes, basting halfway","Serve with rice and steamed veggies"], tags: ["gluten-free","nut-free","dairy-free","egg-free"] },
  { id: "kids-gf-pancakes", name: "GF Fluffy Pancakes", mealType: ["breakfast","lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "15 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["1½ cups GF flour blend","1 cup milk","1 egg","2 tbsp maple syrup","2 tsp baking powder","1 tbsp melted butter","berries and banana to serve"], method: ["Mix flour and baking powder","Whisk milk, egg, maple syrup, butter separately","Combine wet and dry until just mixed","Cook in buttered pan 2-3 min each side","Serve with berries and banana"], tags: ["gluten-free","nut-free"] },
  { id: "kids-gf-meatballs", name: "GF Italian Meatballs", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["500g beef mince","½ cup GF breadcrumbs","1 egg","1 tsp Italian herbs","1 jar passata","GF pasta to serve","parmesan"], method: ["Mix mince, GF breadcrumbs, egg, herbs","Form small balls, brown in pan","Add passata, simmer 15 minutes","Cook GF pasta","Serve meatballs over pasta with parmesan"], tags: ["gluten-free","nut-free"] },
  { id: "kids-gf-fried-rice", name: "GF Chicken Fried Rice", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["200g chicken breast, diced","3 cups cold cooked rice","2 eggs, beaten","1 cup frozen peas and corn","2 tbsp tamari","1 tbsp sesame oil"], method: ["Cook chicken in sesame oil, set aside","Scramble eggs, break into pieces","Add rice, veggies, chicken","Add tamari, toss well","Serve immediately"], tags: ["gluten-free","nut-free","dairy-free"] },
  { id: "kids-gf-nuggets", name: "GF Cornflake Chicken Nuggets", mealType: ["lunch","dinner"], protein: "chicken", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g chicken breast, cubed","1 cup GF cornflake crumbs","½ cup rice flour","1 egg, beaten","½ tsp garlic powder","½ tsp paprika","cooking spray"], method: ["Preheat oven to 200°C","Mix cornflake crumbs, garlic, paprika","Coat chicken: rice flour, egg, crumbs","Spray with oil, bake 15-18 minutes","Serve with GF tomato sauce"], tags: ["gluten-free","nut-free","dairy-free"] },
  { id: "kids-gf-sausage-rolls", name: "GF Sausage Rolls", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "pork", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 8, ingredients: ["400g pork sausage meat","1 carrot, grated","1 zucchini, grated","1 sheet GF puff pastry","1 egg, beaten for glaze"], method: ["Mix sausage meat with grated veggies","Roll out GF pastry","Place filling along one edge, roll up","Brush with egg, cut into portions","Bake at 200°C for 20-25 minutes until golden"], tags: ["gluten-free","nut-free","dairy-free"] },
  { id: "kids-gf-banana-muffins", name: "GF Banana Choc Chip Muffins", mealType: ["breakfast","lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 12, ingredients: ["3 ripe bananas","2 eggs","⅓ cup coconut oil, melted","¼ cup maple syrup","2 cups GF flour blend","1 tsp baking soda","½ cup chocolate chips"], method: ["Preheat oven to 180°C","Mash bananas, mix with eggs, oil, maple","Add GF flour, baking soda, fold in choc chips","Spoon into lined muffin tin","Bake 20-22 minutes until golden"], tags: ["gluten-free","dairy-free"] },
  { id: "kids-gf-beef-tacos", name: "GF Beef Tacos", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "beef", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["400g beef mince","1 tsp cumin","½ tsp paprika","8 corn taco shells","1 cup shredded lettuce","1 tomato, diced","½ cup grated cheese","sour cream"], method: ["Brown mince with cumin and paprika","Warm taco shells","Fill with mince, lettuce, tomato","Top with cheese and sour cream"], tags: ["gluten-free","nut-free","egg-free"], image: "/images/recipes/meals/kids-gf-beef-tacos.png" },

  // ── SAINSBURY'S: LET'S BAKE & COOK WITH KIDS 2025 (FULL COLLECTION) ──
  { id: "kids-sb-chocolate-brownies", name: "Fudgy Chocolate Brownies", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "35 min", serves: 9, ingredients: ["200g dark chocolate","150g butter","3 eggs","1 cup sugar","½ cup flour","¼ cup cocoa powder","pinch salt"], method: ["Preheat oven to 180°C","Melt chocolate and butter together, cool slightly","Whisk eggs and sugar until thick","Fold in chocolate mixture, then flour, cocoa, salt","Pour into lined square tin, bake 22-25 minutes","Cool completely before cutting"], tags: ["nut-free","baking"] },
  { id: "kids-sb-scones", name: "Classic Fruit Scones", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 8, ingredients: ["2 cups self-raising flour","¼ cup sugar","50g cold butter, cubed","½ cup milk","1 egg","½ cup mixed dried fruit","extra milk for glazing"], method: ["Preheat oven to 220°C","Rub butter into flour until breadcrumb texture","Add sugar and fruit","Mix egg with milk, add to dry ingredients","Pat out, cut rounds, brush with milk","Bake 12-15 minutes until golden"], tags: ["nut-free","baking"] },
  { id: "kids-sb-rainbow-cupcakes", name: "Rainbow Swirl Cupcakes", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "40 min", serves: 12, ingredients: ["1 cup butter, softened","1 cup sugar","3 eggs","2 cups self-raising flour","½ cup milk","1 tsp vanilla","food colouring (4 colours)","buttercream: 200g butter, 3 cups icing sugar, 2 tbsp milk"], method: ["Cream butter and sugar, add eggs one at a time","Fold in flour alternating with milk, add vanilla","Divide batter into 4, colour each","Layer colours in cupcake cases","Bake at 180°C for 18-20 minutes","Pipe rainbow buttercream on top"], tags: ["nut-free","baking"] },
  { id: "kids-sb-banana-loaf", name: "Sticky Banana Loaf", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "55 min", serves: 8, ingredients: ["3 ripe bananas","100g butter, melted","¾ cup sugar","2 eggs","1½ cups self-raising flour","1 tsp cinnamon","pinch salt"], method: ["Preheat oven to 170°C","Mash bananas, mix with melted butter and sugar","Beat in eggs","Fold in flour, cinnamon, salt","Pour into lined loaf tin","Bake 45-50 minutes until skewer comes out clean"], tags: ["nut-free","baking"] },
  { id: "kids-sb-jam-tarts", name: "Jam Tarts", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 12, ingredients: ["1 sheet ready-rolled shortcrust pastry","½ cup assorted jams (strawberry, apricot, raspberry)","1 egg, beaten for glaze"], method: ["Preheat oven to 190°C","Cut pastry circles to line a 12-hole tart tin","Add 1 tsp jam to each","Brush edges with egg","Bake 12-15 minutes until pastry golden","Cool before removing from tin"], tags: ["nut-free","baking","vegetarian"] },
  { id: "kids-sb-cheese-straws", name: "Cheesy Twisty Straws", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "cheese", prepTime: "20 min", serves: 12, ingredients: ["1 sheet puff pastry","1 cup finely grated cheddar","½ tsp paprika","1 egg, beaten"], method: ["Preheat oven to 200°C","Brush pastry with egg, sprinkle cheese and paprika","Cut into long strips","Twist each strip, place on lined tray","Bake 10-12 minutes until golden and crisp"], tags: ["nut-free","baking","vegetarian"] },
  { id: "kids-sb-chocolate-chip-cookies", name: "Giant Chocolate Chip Cookies", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "25 min", serves: 12, ingredients: ["200g butter, softened","¾ cup brown sugar","¼ cup caster sugar","1 egg","1 tsp vanilla","2 cups flour","1 tsp baking soda","1 cup chocolate chips"], method: ["Cream butter and sugars","Beat in egg and vanilla","Fold in flour, baking soda","Stir in chocolate chips","Drop large spoonfuls on lined trays","Bake at 180°C for 10-12 minutes"], tags: ["nut-free","baking"] },
  { id: "kids-sb-rocky-road", name: "Rocky Road Bites", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "15 min", serves: 12, ingredients: ["300g milk chocolate","100g butter","2 cups mini marshmallows","1 cup crushed biscuits","½ cup dried cranberries"], method: ["Melt chocolate and butter together","Stir in marshmallows, biscuits, cranberries","Pour into lined square tin","Refrigerate 2 hours until set","Cut into squares"], tags: ["nut-free","baking","no-bake"] },
  { id: "kids-sb-lemon-drizzle", name: "Lemon Drizzle Cake", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "45 min", serves: 8, ingredients: ["200g butter, softened","200g caster sugar","3 eggs","200g self-raising flour","zest of 2 lemons","drizzle: juice of 2 lemons, 100g granulated sugar"], method: ["Preheat oven to 180°C","Cream butter and sugar","Beat in eggs one at a time","Fold in flour and lemon zest","Bake in lined loaf tin 35-40 minutes","While warm, poke holes, pour lemon-sugar drizzle"], tags: ["nut-free","baking"] },
  { id: "kids-sb-flapjacks", name: "Golden Syrup Flapjacks", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 12, ingredients: ["150g butter","100g brown sugar","4 tbsp golden syrup","3 cups rolled oats","pinch salt"], method: ["Preheat oven to 180°C","Melt butter, sugar, golden syrup together","Stir in oats and salt","Press into lined square tin","Bake 20-22 minutes until golden edges","Cool 10 minutes, cut, then cool completely"], tags: ["nut-free","egg-free","baking"] },
  { id: "kids-sb-victoria-sponge", name: "Mini Victoria Sponges", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "35 min", serves: 12, ingredients: ["200g butter, softened","200g caster sugar","4 eggs","200g self-raising flour","1 tsp vanilla","strawberry jam","whipped cream","icing sugar for dusting"], method: ["Cream butter, sugar, vanilla","Beat in eggs one at a time","Fold in flour","Divide into 12 cupcake cases","Bake at 180°C for 15-18 minutes","Cut in half, fill with jam and cream, dust with icing sugar"], tags: ["nut-free","baking"] },
  { id: "kids-sb-pizza-dough", name: "Easy Pizza Dough & Toppings", mealType: ["dinner"], protein: "cheese", prepTime: "40 min", serves: 4, ingredients: ["3 cups flour","1 sachet yeast","1 tsp sugar","1 tsp salt","1 cup warm water","2 tbsp olive oil","toppings: passata, mozzarella, veggies of choice"], method: ["Mix flour, yeast, sugar, salt","Add warm water and oil, knead 5 minutes","Rest 15 minutes","Roll out, spread with passata","Add cheese and toppings","Bake at 220°C for 12-15 minutes"], tags: ["nut-free","egg-free","baking","vegetarian"] },
  { id: "kids-sb-shortbread", name: "Buttery Shortbread Fingers", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "30 min", serves: 16, ingredients: ["250g butter, softened","½ cup caster sugar","2 cups plain flour","½ cup rice flour","pinch salt"], method: ["Preheat oven to 160°C","Cream butter and sugar","Fold in both flours and salt","Press into lined square tin, prick with fork","Bake 25-30 minutes until pale golden","Cut into fingers while warm, cool completely"], tags: ["nut-free","egg-free","baking","vegetarian"] },
  { id: "kids-sb-carrot-cake", name: "Carrot Cake Squares", mealType: ["lunch"], protein: "eggs", prepTime: "45 min", serves: 12, ingredients: ["2 cups grated carrot","1½ cups self-raising flour","1 cup brown sugar","3 eggs","¾ cup vegetable oil","1 tsp cinnamon","½ tsp mixed spice","cream cheese icing: 200g cream cheese, 1 cup icing sugar"], method: ["Preheat oven to 180°C","Mix oil, sugar, eggs","Fold in flour, spices, carrot","Pour into lined square tin","Bake 30-35 minutes","Cool completely, spread cream cheese icing"], tags: ["nut-free","baking"] },

/** Map protein keywords to match adult recipe proteins (meat type, not grams) */
export const PROTEIN_ALIASES: Record<string, string[]> = {
  chicken: ["chicken", "turkey", "poultry"],
  beef: ["beef", "steak", "mince", "lamb", "venison"],
  fish: ["fish", "salmon", "tuna", "cod", "snapper", "prawn", "shrimp", "seafood"],
  tofu: ["tofu", "tempeh"],
  beans: ["bean", "chickpea", "lentil", "legume"],
  lentils: ["lentil", "dhal", "dal"],
  eggs: ["egg", "frittata", "shakshuka", "omelette"],
  cheese: ["cheese", "mac", "halloumi", "ricotta"],
  pork: ["pork", "bacon", "ham", "sausage", "prosciutto"],
  shrimp: ["shrimp", "prawn"],
  none: ["vegan", "plant", "smoothie", "oat", "porridge", "granola", "fruit", "acai", "avocado"],
};

/** Detect similarity tags from adult recipe name */
const SIMILARITY_KEYWORDS: Record<string, string[]> = {
  "pasta": ["pasta", "spaghetti", "penne", "linguine", "fettuccine", "noodle", "lasagne"],
  "rice-bowl": ["rice bowl", "buddha bowl", "grain bowl", "poke"],
  "stir-fry": ["stir fry", "stir-fry", "wok"],
  "curry": ["curry", "korma", "tikka", "masala", "dhal", "dal"],
  "mexican": ["taco", "burrito", "quesadilla", "nacho", "enchilada", "fajita"],
  "asian": ["thai", "japanese", "chinese", "korean", "vietnamese", "miso", "teriyaki", "soy"],
  "crispy": ["crispy", "crumbed", "crusted", "schnitzel", "fried"],
  "soup": ["soup", "chowder", "broth", "stew"],
  "bake": ["bake", "casserole", "gratin", "roast"],
  "wrap": ["wrap", "roll", "burrito", "spring roll"],
  "pizza": ["pizza", "flatbread"],
  "toast": ["toast", "sourdough", "bread"],
  "oats": ["oat", "porridge", "muesli", "bircher", "overnight"],
  "smoothie": ["smoothie", "acai", "bowl"],
  "eggs": ["egg", "scramble", "omelette", "frittata", "shakshuka"],
  "pancake": ["pancake", "waffle", "pikelet", "crepe", "french toast"],
  "salad": ["salad", "slaw"],
  "meatball": ["meatball", "kofta", "rissole"],
  "burger": ["burger", "patty", "rissole"],
};

function detectSimilarityTags(recipeName: string): string[] {
  const lower = recipeName.toLowerCase();
  const tags: string[] = [];
  for (const [tag, keywords] of Object.entries(SIMILARITY_KEYWORDS)) {
    if (keywords.some(k => lower.includes(k))) {
      tags.push(tag);
    }
  }
  return tags;
}

/** Find the best kids recipe matching a protein type, meal type, and dietary restrictions */
export function findKidsRecipe(
  adultRecipeName: string,
  mealType: KidsMealType,
  kidsAllergies: string[],
  kidsDietType: string,
  exclude: string[] = [],
  seed: number = 0,
): KidsRecipe | null {
  // Detect protein (meat type) from adult recipe name
  const lower = adultRecipeName.toLowerCase();
  let detectedProtein = "";
  for (const [protein, aliases] of Object.entries(PROTEIN_ALIASES)) {
    if (aliases.some(a => lower.includes(a))) {
      detectedProtein = protein;
      break;
    }
  }

  // Detect similarity tags from adult recipe
  const adultSimilarity = detectSimilarityTags(adultRecipeName);

  // Filter candidates by meal type and dietary requirements
  let candidates = KIDS_RECIPE_BANK.filter(r => {
    if (!r.mealType.includes(mealType)) return false;
    if (exclude.includes(r.id)) return false;
    // Skip baking-only items for meal alternatives
    if (r.tags.includes("baking") && !r.tags.includes("vegetarian") && !r.tags.includes("vegan")) return false;
    // Check allergies
    for (const allergy of kidsAllergies) {
      const al = allergy.toLowerCase().trim();
      if (!al) continue;
      const tagMap: Record<string, string> = {
        dairy: "dairy-free", gluten: "gluten-free", nut: "nut-free",
        peanut: "nut-free", egg: "egg-free", nuts: "nut-free",
      };
      const requiredTag = tagMap[al] || `${al}-free`;
      if (!r.tags.includes(requiredTag)) {
        const ingLower = r.ingredients.join(" ").toLowerCase();
        if (ingLower.includes(al)) return false;
      }
    }
    // Check diet type
    if (kidsDietType) {
      const dt = kidsDietType.toLowerCase();
      if (dt.includes("vegan") && !r.tags.includes("vegan")) return false;
      if (dt.includes("vegetarian") && !r.tags.includes("vegan") && !r.tags.includes("vegetarian")) return false;
      if (dt.includes("dairy-free") && !r.tags.includes("dairy-free")) return false;
      if (dt.includes("gluten-free") && !r.tags.includes("gluten-free")) return false;
      if (dt.includes("nut-free") && !r.tags.includes("nut-free")) return false;
      if (dt.includes("egg-free") && !r.tags.includes("egg-free")) return false;
      if (dt.includes("keto") && !r.tags.includes("keto")) return false;
    }
    return true;
  });

  if (candidates.length === 0) return null;

  // Score candidates: protein match + similarity overlap
  const scored = candidates.map(r => {
    let score = 0;
    // Protein (meat) match is most important
    if (detectedProtein && r.protein === detectedProtein) score += 10;
    // Similarity tag overlap
    const recipeSim = r.similarity || detectSimilarityTags(r.name);
    const overlap = adultSimilarity.filter(t => recipeSim.includes(t)).length;
    score += overlap * 3;
    return { recipe: r, score };
  });

  // Sort by score descending, then use seed for variety among top matches
  scored.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);

  // Get top tier (recipes with the highest score)
  const topScore = scored[0].score;
  const topTier = scored.filter(s => s.score >= topScore - 2);

  return topTier[seed % topTier.length].recipe;
}

// ── Signal Meditation & Mindfulness Script Library ──────────
// Original Signal content. Frameworks referenced for inspiration only.
// Uses same structure as somatic-scripts.ts for player compatibility.

import { THEO_VOICE_ID, REGINA_VOICE_ID } from "@/lib/script-audio";

export type MeditationCategory = "meditation" | "reading" | "inner-work" | "sleep" | "phase-practice";
export type CyclePhase = "menstrual" | "follicular" | "ovulatory" | "luteal";

export interface MeditationStep {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  body: string;
  startTimeSec?: number;
  endTimeSec?: number;
}

export interface MeditationScript {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  category: MeditationCategory;
  durationSec: number;
  description: string;
  ttsScript: string;
  steps: MeditationStep[];
  phase?: CyclePhase[] | "all";
  tags: string[];
  evidenceSource: string;
  backgroundMusic?: "none" | "gentle" | "nature" | "binaural";
  voiceId?: string;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// GUIDED MEDITATIONS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

const medBodyScan: MeditationScript = {
  id: "med-001",
  title: "The Signal Body Scan",
  subtitle: "Full-body awareness meditation",
  category: "meditation",
  durationSec: 1200,
  description: "A 20-minute progressive body scan that moves attention from the feet to the crown, building interoceptive awareness and releasing held tension. Signal's foundational meditation.",
  evidenceSource: "MBSR body scan research (Kabat-Zinn); Polyvagal Theory (Porges)",
  tags: ["nervous-system", "body-awareness", "sleep", "all-phases"],
  phase: "all",
  backgroundMusic: "gentle",
  ttsScript: `Find a comfortable position. Lying down is ideal, but sitting is fine too. Let your body be supported. You don't need to hold anything up right now.

Close your eyes, or let your gaze soften downward.

Take three slow breaths. Not deep, not forced. Just a little slower than your natural rhythm. In through the nose. Out through the mouth.

We're going to move attention through your body. Not to fix anything. Not to change anything. Just to notice. The only task here is noticing.

Begin with your feet. Feel the weight of them. The soles, the toes, the arches. Maybe there's warmth. Maybe tension. Maybe nothing. All of that is fine.

Move to your ankles. Your shins. Your calves. Notice the texture of sensation here — heaviness, lightness, tingling, stillness. Whatever you find, let it be.

Now your knees. The backs of your knees. Your thighs. The muscles here carry so much of your day. Just acknowledge them.

Your hips. Your pelvis. This is the body's centre of gravity. Let it be heavy. Let the surface beneath you take the weight.

Your lower back. The sacrum. Many women hold tension here without knowing it. Breathe into it. Not to release — just to acknowledge.

Your belly. Let it be soft. We spend so much time holding our stomachs in. Right now, let it go. Let your belly rise and fall with each breath.

Your ribs. Your chest. Feel the expansion and contraction of breathing. The heart beating beneath. Steady, quiet, always working for you.

Your shoulders. Let them drop. Whatever you're carrying — set it down for these next few minutes.

Your arms. Your elbows. Your forearms. Your wrists. Your hands. Your fingers. Notice any warmth, any pulsing, any stillness.

Your neck. Your throat. The jaw. Let your teeth part slightly. Soften the muscles around your eyes.

Your forehead. The crown of your head.

Now hold your whole body in awareness. All at once. One living, breathing whole. You don't have to do anything with it. Just be here. Just be this.

Stay here for a moment. Breathing. Being.

When you're ready, begin to move your fingers and toes. Take a deeper breath. And gently open your eyes.

You have just practised the most fundamental act of self-care — paying attention to yourself.`,
  steps: [
    { id: "s1", title: "Settle", body: "Find a comfortable position. Take three slow breaths.", startTimeSec: 0, endTimeSec: 60 },
    { id: "s2", title: "Feet & Legs", body: "Move attention through your feet, ankles, shins, calves, knees, and thighs.", startTimeSec: 60, endTimeSec: 300 },
    { id: "s3", title: "Hips & Core", body: "Notice your hips, pelvis, lower back, and belly. Let your belly be soft.", startTimeSec: 300, endTimeSec: 540 },
    { id: "s4", title: "Chest & Shoulders", body: "Feel your ribs, chest, and shoulders. Let them drop.", startTimeSec: 540, endTimeSec: 720 },
    { id: "s5", title: "Arms & Hands", body: "Move through your arms, wrists, hands, fingers.", startTimeSec: 720, endTimeSec: 840 },
    { id: "s6", title: "Head & Face", body: "Soften your jaw, eyes, forehead. Reach the crown.", startTimeSec: 840, endTimeSec: 1020 },
    { id: "s7", title: "Whole Body", body: "Hold your whole body in awareness. Just be here.", startTimeSec: 1020, endTimeSec: 1140 },
    { id: "s8", title: "Return", body: "Gently begin to move and open your eyes.", startTimeSec: 1140, endTimeSec: 1200 },
  ],
};

const medRain: MeditationScript = {
  id: "med-002",
  title: "RAIN — Working with Difficult Emotions",
  subtitle: "Meet what you feel with compassion",
  category: "meditation",
  durationSec: 900,
  description: "Guides you through Recognise, Allow, Investigate, and Nurture — a four-step process for meeting difficult emotions with compassion rather than resistance. Inspired by the RAIN framework.",
  evidenceSource: "RAIN framework (Brach); self-compassion research (Neff)",
  tags: ["emotional-processing", "self-compassion", "luteal", "menstrual"],
  phase: ["menstrual", "luteal"],
  backgroundMusic: "gentle",
  ttsScript: `Settle into a comfortable position. Let your body be held by whatever surface is beneath you.

This practice is for when something feels difficult. An emotion. A thought. A weight you've been carrying. You don't need to know what it is yet. Just notice that something is here.

The first step is to Recognise. Simply name what's present. Not to analyse. Just to acknowledge. You might say silently: "I notice anxiety." Or "There's sadness here." Or "Something feels heavy." Just name it. That's enough.

The second step is to Allow. This is the hardest part. We want to fix, push away, distract, numb. Instead — just allow it to be here. You're not approving of it. You're not making it permanent. You're just letting it exist without fighting it. Say to yourself: "I can let this be here."

The third step is to Investigate. With gentleness, ask: where do I feel this in my body? What does it feel like? Is there a younger part of me that knows this feeling? You're not looking for answers. You're looking with curiosity.

The final step is to Nurture. Place a hand on your heart, or wherever feels natural. Offer yourself what you would offer a close friend: "I see you. This is hard. You don't have to carry this alone."

Stay here with this feeling of nurture. Breathing. Holding yourself.

The luteal and menstrual phases bring emotions closer to the surface. This is not a malfunction. This is your biology giving you access to what needs attention. Trust it.

When you're ready, take a deeper breath. Open your eyes. Carry this gentleness forward.`,
  steps: [
    { id: "s1", title: "Settle", body: "Find your position. Notice that something is present.", startTimeSec: 0, endTimeSec: 60 },
    { id: "s2", title: "Recognise", body: "Name what's here. 'I notice…'", startTimeSec: 60, endTimeSec: 240 },
    { id: "s3", title: "Allow", body: "Let it exist without fighting. 'I can let this be here.'", startTimeSec: 240, endTimeSec: 420 },
    { id: "s4", title: "Investigate", body: "Where is this in your body? What does it feel like?", startTimeSec: 420, endTimeSec: 600 },
    { id: "s5", title: "Nurture", body: "Offer yourself compassion. Place a hand on your heart.", startTimeSec: 600, endTimeSec: 840 },
    { id: "s6", title: "Return", body: "Breathe. Open your eyes. Carry this gentleness forward.", startTimeSec: 840, endTimeSec: 900 },
  ],
};

const medLovingKindness: MeditationScript = {
  id: "med-003",
  title: "Loving-Kindness — Beginning with Yourself",
  subtitle: "Metta meditation for self-compassion",
  category: "meditation",
  durationSec: 900,
  description: "A loving-kindness practice that begins with the self before extending to others. Opens with an acknowledgement of the difficulty most women have in receiving care for themselves.",
  evidenceSource: "Frederickson (2008) loving-kindness; Salzberg Metta tradition",
  tags: ["self-compassion", "warmth", "nervous-system"],
  phase: "all",
  backgroundMusic: "gentle",
  ttsScript: `Close your eyes. Settle into your body.

Here is a truth most women know but rarely say aloud: it is easier to give care than to receive it. Easier to hold others than to be held. Easier to love outward than inward.

This practice begins where it should — with you.

Place your hands wherever they feel natural. On your lap. On your heart. On your belly.

Repeat these phrases silently, directed at yourself:

May I be safe. May I be healthy. May I be at peace. May I live with ease.

Don't worry if you don't believe them yet. The practice is the repetition, not the belief. Say them anyway.

May I be safe. May I be healthy. May I be at peace. May I live with ease.

Now think of someone you care about. Hold their face in your mind. Direct the same words to them:

May you be safe. May you be healthy. May you be at peace. May you live with ease.

Now expand further. Think of someone neutral — someone you don't know well. Offer the same:

May you be safe. May you be healthy. May you be at peace. May you live with ease.

Finally, expand to all beings. All women. All people struggling right now:

May all beings be safe. May all beings be healthy. May all beings be at peace. May all beings live with ease.

Return to yourself. One more time:

May I be safe. May I be healthy. May I be at peace. May I live with ease.

You deserve the care you give so freely to others.`,
  steps: [
    { id: "s1", title: "Settle", body: "Close your eyes. Acknowledge that receiving care is hard.", startTimeSec: 0, endTimeSec: 90 },
    { id: "s2", title: "Self", body: "Direct loving-kindness to yourself. May I be safe…", startTimeSec: 90, endTimeSec: 300 },
    { id: "s3", title: "Loved One", body: "Think of someone you care about. Offer the same words.", startTimeSec: 300, endTimeSec: 480 },
    { id: "s4", title: "Neutral Person", body: "Extend to someone you don't know well.", startTimeSec: 480, endTimeSec: 600 },
    { id: "s5", title: "All Beings", body: "Expand to all beings everywhere.", startTimeSec: 600, endTimeSec: 750 },
    { id: "s6", title: "Return to Self", body: "Come back to yourself. You deserve this care.", startTimeSec: 750, endTimeSec: 900 },
  ],
};

const medRelaxationResponse: MeditationScript = {
  id: "med-004",
  title: "The Relaxation Response",
  subtitle: "Evidence-based stress reduction",
  category: "meditation",
  durationSec: 600,
  description: "The evidence-based relaxation technique from Dr. Herbert Benson at Harvard — one of the first scientifically validated meditation protocols. Two conditions: a mental device and a passive attitude. 10 minutes reduces cortisol measurably.",
  evidenceSource: "Benson et al. (1974–2000); multiple RCTs on cortisol, blood pressure, anxiety",
  tags: ["stress-reduction", "parasympathetic", "nervous-system", "evidence-based"],
  phase: "all",
  backgroundMusic: "none",
  ttsScript: `Sit comfortably. Close your eyes.

This practice was developed at Harvard Medical School. It has one purpose: to activate your body's built-in relaxation system. It requires two things — a focus word, and a passive attitude.

Choose a word to repeat silently. Something neutral and calming. "Release" works well. "Peace" works. "Let go" works. Choose whatever feels right.

Now begin repeating that word silently on each exhale. Breathe in naturally. As you breathe out, silently say your word.

Release. Release. Release.

When thoughts come — and they will — simply notice them and return to the word. Don't judge the thoughts. Don't judge yourself for having them. Just return to the word. This passive return is the practice.

Continue breathing. Continue repeating.

There's nothing to achieve here. No state to reach. The repetition itself activates the response. Your heart rate is slowing. Your blood pressure is dropping. Cortisol is clearing.

Keep going. Breath in. Word on the exhale.

You are doing something profoundly simple and profoundly powerful.

Continue for the next few minutes. If you lose the word, find it again. No rush. No effort.

When you hear the gentle chime, keep your eyes closed for another moment. Then slowly open them. Sit quietly for a moment before standing.

Well done. Ten minutes of this practice changes your biochemistry for hours.`,
  steps: [
    { id: "s1", title: "Choose Your Word", body: "Pick a neutral focus word — 'release', 'peace', or your own.", startTimeSec: 0, endTimeSec: 60 },
    { id: "s2", title: "Begin Repeating", body: "Silently say the word on each exhale. Breathe naturally.", startTimeSec: 60, endTimeSec: 180 },
    { id: "s3", title: "Passive Return", body: "When thoughts come, notice and return to the word.", startTimeSec: 180, endTimeSec: 360 },
    { id: "s4", title: "Deepening", body: "Continue repeating. Your body is responding.", startTimeSec: 360, endTimeSec: 540 },
    { id: "s5", title: "Return", body: "Keep eyes closed a moment. Then slowly open.", startTimeSec: 540, endTimeSec: 600 },
  ],
};

  backgroundMusic: "gentle",
  ttsScript: `Lie down or recline. Close your eyes. You're going to rest — deeply — without sleeping.

Take a long exhale. Longer than your inhale. Let your body become heavy.

Bring your attention to the space behind your eyelids. There's nothing to see, nothing to visualise. Just rest in that darkness.

Feel the weight of your body. Let every muscle release. Your jaw. Your shoulders. Your hands. Your legs.

Breathe naturally. On each exhale, feel yourself sink a little deeper into the surface beneath you. Not sleeping. Just resting.

Your mind may produce thoughts, images, fragments. Let them pass like clouds. You don't need to follow them. You don't need to push them away.

This is not sleep. This is a deliberate neurological rest state. Your brain is clearing adenosine, restoring dopamine, consolidating learning. All you need to do is lie here.

Continue resting. If you drift toward sleep, that's fine. If you stay awake, that's fine too. The practice is the same.

Let the next few minutes be completely yours. No tasks. No obligations. Just rest.

When you hear the gentle tone, begin to move your fingers and toes. Take a few deeper breaths. Roll to one side if you're lying down. And when you're ready, come back to the room. Refreshed. Restored.`,

Ask it: "What do you need?" Again, listen. The answer might come as a word, a feeling, an image, or nothing. All responses are valid.

Now offer it compassion. Say: "Thank you for trying to protect me. I'm here now. You don't have to work so hard."

Sit with this. Breathing. Holding this part of yourself the way you would hold a child who's been scared.

const readRealSelfCare: MeditationScript = {
  id: "read-002",
  title: "What Real Self-Care Actually Is",
  subtitle: "Beyond the bath bombs",
  category: "reading",
  durationSec: 480,
  description: "A Signal essay on the difference between performative self-care and authentic self-care — values clarification, saying no, making hard decisions.",
  evidenceSource: "Lakshmin Real Self-Care framework; Signal philosophy",
  tags: ["self-care", "boundaries", "inner-work", "reflection"],
  phase: "all",
  backgroundMusic: "none",
  ttsScript: `There's a version of self-care that gets sold to women constantly. It involves products, pampering, and treats. Face masks. Bubble baths. Wine at the end of a long day.

There's nothing wrong with any of those things. But they're not self-care. They're comfort. And comfort is not the same as care.

Real self-care is harder. It's less Instagram-friendly. It looks like setting a boundary with someone you love. It looks like saying no to something everyone expects you to say yes to. It looks like sitting with an uncomfortable emotion instead of numbing it.

Real self-care asks: what do I actually need right now? Not what would feel good for five minutes — but what would genuinely serve me?

Sometimes the answer is rest. Sometimes it's movement. Sometimes it's a difficult conversation. Sometimes it's asking for help.

The question isn't "what can I do to treat myself?" The question is "what does my body, my mind, my nervous system actually need?"

And here's what makes this cycle-relevant: different phases create different needs. Your luteal phase might need boundaries. Your menstrual phase might need permission to do nothing. Your follicular phase might need challenge.

Real self-care is listening to those signals. Not overriding them with someone else's wellness plan.

What does real self-care look like for you today? Sit with that for a moment.`,

  ],
};

  title: "The Body Keeps the Score",
  subtitle: "Why somatic practices work",
  category: "reading",
  durationSec: 600,

  phase: ["menstrual", "luteal"],
  backgroundMusic: "gentle",
  ttsScript: `Here is something that changes everything once you understand it: your body remembers what your mind forgets.

Every experience you've had — every stress, every joy, every moment of fear or safety — is stored not just in your memory, but in your muscles, your fascia, your nervous system, your breath patterns.

This is why you can feel anxious for no apparent reason. Why certain situations trigger reactions that seem disproportionate. Why you might tense your shoulders without knowing it, or hold your breath when you're concentrating.

Your body is not malfunctioning. It's remembering.

This is the foundation of somatic healing — the understanding that the body and mind are not separate systems. They are one system.

When we practise breathwork, body scans, or movement, we're not just "relaxing." We're giving the body a chance to complete stress cycles that got interrupted. To release tension that's been held — sometimes for years.

The menstrual phase often surfaces emotions and body memories that feel disproportionate. This isn't breakdown. This is the body completing unfinished processing. Your biology is giving you a window to heal — if you'll let it.

You don't need to understand why your body holds what it holds. You just need to give it permission to let go. That's what these practices are for.

Your body has been carrying this so you didn't have to. Now you're here. You're paying attention. That's the beginning.`,

  title: "The Stories We Tell Ourselves",
  subtitle: "Inner work essay series",
  category: "reading",

  phase: ["menstrual", "luteal"],

  ttsScript: `You are the author of a story you've been telling for years. It's a story about who you are, what you're capable of, what you deserve, and what's possible.

Most of this story was written before you were old enough to question it. Pieces were written by your parents, your teachers, your earliest experiences. Other people's opinions became your inner voice. Their limitations became your boundaries.

The thing about stories is this: they feel like facts. "I'm not good at this." "I always do that." "People like me don't get to have that." These feel true because you've been repeating them so long. But they're not truth. They're narrative.

And here's what's powerful: you can edit the narrative. Not by pretending the past didn't happen. Not by positive affirmations that feel hollow. But by questioning. By asking: "Is this actually true? Or is this a story I've been telling?"

The menstrual and luteal phases are when these stories surface most clearly. The inner critic gets louder. The self-doubt feels more real. But this isn't your cycle making you weak. It's your cycle giving you access to the material.

Here's your journaling prompt: What story am I telling about myself that might not be true? Write for five minutes. Don't edit. Don't judge. Just let it come.`,
